tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi rgyud gzhung sgrub thabs dbang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// kthakwa/kwa/ཿ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs

chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas padma gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i ye shes dang mjal/ ḍā ki gar gyi dbang phyug mos bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med la gsol pa: ngo mtshar ba'i tshig kye bcom ldan dgyes chen 'od dpag med: don che 'khor dgos pa ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phyir: gang zhun yig bdun gsang sgrub bka' stsol cig: ces ched du che bar zhus so: bcom ldan 'das kyis gar gyi dbang phyug la sogs pa'i padma rigs kyi sems dpa' drug khri 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams la bka' stsal pa: spro ba bskyed pa de don dbang phyug mos zhus pa legs so: gnang ba'i skabs dbye ba gus pa'i yid kyis gsang sgrub nyon: sgrub po'i mtshan nyid bstan dad brtson rigs ldan skyes bu yis: rang lus sems dben gnas sgrub gnas bstan/ brten nas: sbyor dngos rjes gsum gsang sgrub sdom: sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang : dngos gzhi ma yengs ting 'dzin gsum: lus ngag yid kyi dkyil 'khor te: rtog med ngang chos nyid ma skyes pa'i ngang du gnas las rang rig hrīḥ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i mdangs/ dkar dmar 'od ldan gdan steng du: gsang sngags rgyal po 'bru drug bskor: de nyid ma yengs yi ge'i mdangs 'od phung las: thugs rje chen po yig bdun pa: sku dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: dbu gtsug rigs kyi gtso bo bzhugs: phyag g.yas pad 'bru'i phreng ba 'dzin: g.yon pas bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams: rgyan med gcer bu gzi mdangs can: 'gro don zhabs gnyis zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin bzhengs tshul du: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: thugs kar yig 'bru gsal bar ldan: snang la rang bzhin med pa gcig: mi brjed pa yi tshul du bsgom: lus lha'i dkyil 'khor dang po'o: de nas ngag tu yig bdun brjod:

tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyong yi ge'i 'phro 'du las: tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyang 'phro 'du 'od 'phros bde gshegs mnyes mchod 'bul: tshur 'dus sku gsung dngos grub thob: bdag gi sgrib gnyis byang bar bsam: yang gcig brjod pas 'od 'phros pas: 'gro drug sgrib sbyangs bdag 'drar gyur: 'od du 'bar ba'i zhing la bkod: bdag gis sngags gnas 'gyur gzhi la bkod pa'i 'phro 'du/ brjod kun gyis brjod: gsang brtags don gyis bstod cing : dbyangs dang bcas pa'i nyams gsal 'debs kyi 'phro 'du dbyangs 'phel bas: ma yengs grags stong nyam 'phel ba'i 'phro 'du grags stong di ri ri: ngag sgra'i 'khor lo gnyis pa'o: skyo na so so'i rnam pa las: yi ge drug gi 'od zer phog: thams cad yi ge drug par gyur: bdag gi ba spu'i bu gar thim: bdag nyid gdan nas rim gyis su: snying ga'i yig drug dag la bsdu: yig drug hrīḥ bdag nyid ye shes rab tu rdzogs rim/ las 'od du 'dus: hrīḥyang gi gu dag la 'dus: gi gu me long has btab bzhin: mtha' nas dbus su yal ba ni: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa yin: bdag med don la ma yengs gnas: ma 'gags rol par shes par bya: yid kyi 'khor lo gsum pa'o: rjes kyi dkyil 'khor rnam gsum yang : lus med lus te lus lus kyi mtha' thams cad/ kyi mchog: yang dag ngag gi mtha' mtha' ste yi ge med: rnam yid kyi mtha' par rtog med lhun gyis grub: mtha' med dbus kyang yod ma cho sku yin: thugs rje chen po cir bzang ngan rtog pa las 'das pa chos nyid kyi ngang mi dgongs: shes rab mig ldan kun gyi rung : thun mong 'gro ba'i don byed na: me chu gnyis la yig bdun bris: mchod rten gsal byed de bzhin no: des kyang 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: zhes bka' stsal to: thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi rgyud las:

yang snying gsang sgrub kyi le'u ste bdun pa'o: le'u khol du bsdus pa lags: sems can gyi rgyud la buddha rang bzhin gyis gab nas gnas te: mthong nas sgrub pa'i phyir ro: kā caka ka gi: thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs la phyag 'tshal lo: 'khor ba dong sprugs rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa las: rgyud kyi le'u'i khong snying le'u bdun pa 'di bshad na spyi don gsum ste: gar gyi dbang phyug mas bcom ldan 'od dpag med la thugs rje chen po yi ge bdun pa zhu tshul bstan pa dang : bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ba'i skabs phye ba dang : sgrub thabs dong sprugs bka' stsal pa'o: dang po zhu tshul la gnyis te: don ched gang la dgongs pa dang : zhu don dngos so: gnang ba'i skabs dbye ba la gnyis te: zhu ba po spro ba bskyed pa dang : yid la zung zhig par bstan pa'o: sgrub thabs dngos la'ang gnyis: sgrub pa po rten gyi gang zag bstan pa dang : sgrub pa nyams su blang ba'i rim pa'o: dang po la gnyis te: mtshan nyid bstan pa dang : dben gnas bstan pa'o: sgrub pa nyams su blang ba'i rim pa la: sbyor ba dang : dngos gzhi dang : rjes dang : thun mong gi 'gro don dang bzhi'o: dang po la gnyis te: skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed do: dngos gzhi la gsum ste: lus lha'i 'khor lo dang : ngag sngags kyi 'khor lo dang : yid ting nge 'dzin rdzogs pa'i 'khor lo dang gsum mo: lha la'ang sa ma ti gsum ste: yig 'bru rgyu'i sa ma ti dang : 'od spungs sku'i sa ma ti dang : zung 'jug rdzogs pa'i sa ma ti'o: gnyis pa sngags kyi 'phro 'du la'ang bzhi ste: tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyong gi 'phro 'du dang : 'gro drug gnas 'gyur zhing la bkod pa'i 'phro 'du dang : bstod pa gsol 'debs kyi 'phro 'du dang : grags stong nyams 'phel gyi 'phro 'du'o: yid ting nge 'dzin rdzogs pa la gsum ste: snang ba bdag la bsdu ba'i rdzogs rim dang :

bdag yig 'bru la bsdu ba'i rdzogs rim dang : 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i rdzogs rim mo: rjes 'bras bu thob tshul la bzhi ste: lus kyi mtha' dang : ngag gi mtha' dang : yid kyi mtha' dang : thugs rje chen po'i mtha' gang gis bzung ba'o: thun mong 'gro ba'i don bya thabs la bzhi ste: me mkha' khyab kyi 'gro don dang : chu bo dbyings khyab kyi 'gro don dang : dmigs gtad mchod rten gyi 'gro don dang : me long lam pa'i 'gro don no: rgyud kyi rgyal po 'khor ba dong sprugs las: yang snying le'u bdun pa'i sa ma ti'i 'grel ba'o: ༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so: chos dbang gi u pa de sha'o: ṭam ra a ba: thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa la: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba: na mo/ sku gsum thugs rjer ldan pa'i bla ma dkon mchog la: sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: kye ma: rtog 'khrul ngan pa'i sems can rnams: rang ngo ma shes sdug la gtad: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phyir: snying rje chen por sems bskyed do: zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed: de nas lha bskyed pa: rang gi sems nyid dus gsum gyi rtog pa dang bral nas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang las: sna tshogs padma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor: de'i steng du rang gi rig pa ma 'gags pa'i ngo bo hrīḥdakar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyi mthar oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyis bskor ba: de rnams 'od dmar por 'khyil te zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las: rang nyid thugs rje chen po yi ge bdun pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: dbu gtsug snang ba mtha' yas sprul sku'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa: phyag g.yas dbang sdud kyi phyag rgyas padma dmar po'i phreng ba bsnams shing : g.yon mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas spyi blugs bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa:

zhi ma khro'i cha lugs gcer bu rgyan thams cad spangs pa: zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa las 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing snang la rang bzhin med pa zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sku lus lha'i 'khor lo: thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyi mthar oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ gis bskor bar gyur: thugs ka'i yi ge bdun las 'od zer 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum 'od zer dang bcas pa bdag gi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs: yang 'od 'phros pas 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur: snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang : bcud thams cad thugs rje chen por snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can yi ge drug pa'i sgra di ri ri sgrogs par gyur: ngag sngags kyi 'khor lo'o: bzlas pa mang du bya'o// de nas phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod: rtsa ba don rtags kyi sgo nas bstod do: de nas rang gi thugs ka'i yi ge bdun las 'od zer 'phros: snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu: rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas tshur 'dus bdag la thim: bdag kyang thugs ka'i yi ge drug la thim: de'ang dbus kyi hrīḥl thim: hrīḥyang rim pa bzhin gi gu la thim: gi gu'ang mi dmigs par gyur: de dran rtog thugs kyi 'khor lo'o: de'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis thugs rje chen por gyur: gtor ma 'bul ba ni: rin po che'i snod du zas phud zhim dgu mngar bcu'i gtor chen bshams la: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥlan gsum gyis gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin thams cad sbyangs: yang yig bdun lan gsum gyis snod bcud 'jig rten dang mnyam par spel:

yang lan bdun gyis khams gsum 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad mdun du bkug: hrīḥ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas thams cad thugs rje chen por 'gyur: hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs: kun gyis gtor ma gsol bar gyur: gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥb liṃ ta khā hi khā hi: 'gro ba rnams kyi dbang po lnga'i sgo ru 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pas tshim par gyur: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bdag mchod kun mnyes dngos grub ya mtshan chen por gyur: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong khams gsum 'gro drug sems can thams cad khyab par gtor mas tshims te: bdag med spros bral kun khyab ma bcos rang mdangs su sal le bzhag pas: sgo gsum gtor ma chos kyi dbyings su thongs par gyur cig: ci byas dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis: 'gro drug bde ba thob par shog: 'gro rnams bde chen sar gnas shog: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par shog: 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so: i thi: ༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi dbang chog bzhugs so: lantsa kha shas bris 'dug thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje chen po'i gsang sgrub yi ge bdun pa zab mo thugs ka'i dbang 'di la gsum ste: sbyor ba: dngos gzhi: rjes so: dang po la gsum ste: dkyil 'khor bsham pa dang : skyabs 'gro sems bskyed: ye shes dbab pa'o: dang po ni sa gtsang ma la maṇḍal dpe'u chung ltar bris pa'i dbus su: mañdzi'am 'bru'i steng du bum pa rgyan ldan bcud dang bcas pa bshams pa'i steng du sman phud bhandha'i steng du me long la yi ge bdun pa bris la bsham: padma brtsegs pa'i gtor ma dang mchod pa lnga bsham: chos skyong gtor ma dang 'byung po'i gtor ma bsham:

tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bsham: de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sgrub thabs ltar bya'o: de nas ye shes dbab pa ni: dar gyi cod pan me tog dang bcas pa slob mas thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ste 'di skad zhu'o: e ma ho: bdag gi rig pa'i me tog 'di: bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dbang dang dngos grub thob bya'i phyir: thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol: pra ti pū dza hoḥ pho brang du dor ro: de nas slob ma rnams la: 'o ma yengs par 'di ltar bsgoms shig: snang ba thams cad 'od dmar po'i rang bzhin zhing khams yal yal sgoms shig: rang gi spyi gtsug na bla ma snang ba mtha' yas dang tha mi dad pa gzi brjid dang ldan pa bzhugs nas: rigs kyi bu bde ba can gyi gnas su yar shog yar shog gsungs par sgoms shig: rang nyid thugs rje chen po bzhengs skur bsgom: snang srid thams cad yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dang dpa' mo gar byed rol mo mang po sgrogs shing byin gyis brlabs par bsams la: rig pa 'phang bstod cing gsol 'debs dang yi ge bdun pa di ri ri sgrogs par bsgom: rol mo dang bcas pas spos bsreg go /rjes kyi shes pa gsal stong 'dzin med de rang thugs rje chen por ngo sprad do: dngos gzhi la gsum ste: lha bsnyen cing sgrub pa dang : dbang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa dang : dbang bskur ba'o: dang po ni sgrub thabs ltar ro: gnyis pa ni bum pa la gzungs thag btags te: me long la sogs lha gsum du gsal te yi ge bdun pa bzlas pas: de'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer kha dog gsum byung ste slob ma'i sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag nas sku gsung thugs su dbang bskur bar bsam mo: gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni: slob ma'i spyi gtsug tu bum pa bzhag ste: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: zhes khrus bya'o: de ni bum pa'i dbang ngo : de nas bdud rtsi ngag tu blud cing :

oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: zhes lce la myang ba ni gsang dbang ngo : de nas me long thugs kar gtad la: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes me long bstan la rig pa me long ltar gsal la 'dzin med du bde lhan bzhag go: de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo : de nas tshig dbang bskur te: snying gar mdzub mo btsugs nas: sems nyid ma bcos klong yangs na: rang byung thugs rje chen po bzhugs: gsal la mi rtog bde bar bzhugs: thugs rje chen por dbang bskur ro: zhes ngo sprad pa tshig dbang ngo : rjes la gsum ste: gtor ma gtong ba dang : dam tshig dbog pa dang : yon 'bul ba'o: dang po ni bla ma yi dam thugs rje chen po'i tshogs la 'bul: gnyis pa chos skyong la rang gzhung gis 'bul: 'byung po la kha 'bar mas btang ngo : gnyis pa dam tshig tu thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen bsgrub rgyun du bya'o: gzhan don ma yin pa'i las la mi 'jug go: gsum pa gser gyi maṇḍal la sogs pa 'bul: sgrub pa'i dam bca' 'bul lo: bla mas bsngo ba smon lam bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: hrī: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs kyi: rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: lha dbang lus kyis thob par shog: hrīḥ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs kyi: gsang dbang bdud rtsi'i dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: gsang dbang ngag gis thob par shog: hrīḥ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs kyi: shes rab ye shes dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: chos dbang sems kyis thob par shog: hrī: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs kyi: tshig dbang rin chen dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par shog: ༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi dbang gi bkol byang bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi dbang bskur ba la gsum ste:

lha dbang lus la dbang bskur ba dang : gsang dbang ngag la bskur ba dang : chos dbang sems la bskur ba'o: dang po slob ma'i spyi bor thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi sku yongs rdzogs dbang bskur te: rnam par mi rtog nam mkha' la: rang byung thugs rje chen po shar: rtsol bral 'gro ba 'dren pa'i gtso: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: sangs rgyas mtha' yas dbu gtsug brgyan: thugs kar yig bdun gsal bar blta: phyag g.yas pad 'bru'i phreng ba 'dzin: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams: rgyan med gcer bu 'dzum mdangs ldan: skal ldan khyed la dbang bskur bas: lha dbang lus la rdzogs gyur cig: las dang skal bar ldan pa'i slob ma khyod la rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis thugs rje chen po yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur bas thugs rje chen po sku lnga ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can du sangs rgyas nas: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par gyur cig: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bskyed rim dbog: gnyis pa gsang dbang ngag la bskur ba ni: yig bdun slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag cing : spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs ka nas: sngags phreng 'od zer dmar po 'phros: rang byung yi ge bdun du shar: yig drug rigs drug sgrib pa sbyangs: hrīḥni ngan song skye sgo gcod: dus gsum sangs rgyas yang snying 'dis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsung 'grub nas: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i dbang thob shog: las dang skal bar ldan pa'i slob ma khyod la gsung yi ge bdun pa'i dbang bskur bas: bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung du 'grub nas grags stong dbyer med kyi ngang la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur cig: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥwāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ skabs 'dir bsnyen lung dbog: gsum pa chos dbang sems la bskur ba ni: me long gi khar shel bzhag pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la 'di skad do:

thugs rje chen po rang dang gnyis su med: gzhan nas btsal med chos sku skye ba med: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rang byung rig pa rang gsal chos kyi sku: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes slob ma rnams la shel dang me long bstan la: las dang skal par ldan pa'i slob ma rnams ltos shig: rig pa dri ma med pa shel lta bu: gsal la sgrib pa med pa shel lta bu: sna tshogs su shar kyang shel gyi gdan dang gzhan gyis kha dog sgyur ba yin gyi: ngo bo shel las g.yos pa med pa bzhin du rang gi rig pa byang chub kyi sems 'di thugs rje chen po las g.yos pa med do: zhes brjod cing skabs 'dir sku snang stong dbyer med: gsung grags stong dbyer med: thugs rig stong dbyer med du ngo sprad do: gsum pa thun mong gi dbang ni: gtor ma'i dbang dang bka' lung gi dbang las: dang po gtor ma'i dbang ni slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la: gtor snod rin chen gzhal yas khang : gtor ma 'dod yon rnam pa lnga: yi dam lha ru mnga' gsol bas: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: yi dam 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan gyi: phrin las yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī:trām̐: zhes gnas lngar gtugs: las dang skal bar ldan pa'i slob ma khyod la gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas: thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnam pa lnga'i dbang thob nas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par gyur cig: gnyis pa bka' lung gi dbang ni po ti slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la: las dang skal bar ldan pa'i slob ma khyod la 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi chos nyan du rung ba'i dbang dang : sgom par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang : 'gro don byed pa byin rlabs kyi dbang rnams thob nas khyed rnams snying rje chen po byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig:

rang rang gi ming 'jug tu bcug la: sems can gcig gi don byed par gyur cig: gnyis kyi don byed par gyur cig: de bzhin du bcu'i bar du bcug ste 'gro don byed par gyur cig: nyi shu nas brgya'i bar 'gro don byed par gyur cig: stong gi khri'i 'bum gyi sa ya'i bye ba'i dung phyur gyi ther 'bum gyi khrag khrig gi stong dang po'i sems can/ stong gnyis pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i sems can gyi don gyi byed par gyur cig: sprul sku'i zhing khams kyi: longs sku'i zhing khams kyi: chos sku'i zhing khams kyi don byed par gyur cig: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ dharma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ khyed rnams thugs rje chen po'i bka' lung thob pa yin pas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs lta bu'i 'gro don rgya chen po 'grub pa yin no: zhes brjod do: i thi: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rdza bar yang ban chos dbang gi snying thig go: 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ ḍā ki gar gyi dbang mo/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas/ mtsho rgyal/ chos dbang*/ sras mo drin can ma/ chos nyid rang grol/ sangs rgyas lhun dbang*/ sba ston rdo rje gzhon nu/ sba ston dkon mchog dpal bzang*/ gnubs ston rin chen dpal bzang*/ rgyal sras padma 'byung gnas/ dge slong dam pa bkra shis dpal/ rje smon lam rgyal mtshan/ yang na/ chos dbang rin po che nas/ sman lung mi bskyod rdo rje/ dwags ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ gnyan ston ye shes rdo rje/ se sdings pa gu ru chen po/ karma dpal 'byor/ chos kyi dbang po/ karma gu ru yab sras/ blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje/ des bdag la'o// yang*/ blo gros mchog gi rdo rjes bla ma chu mig pa ngag dbang phun tshogs la pho brang po ta lar gsan pa'o// ༈ /'khor ba dong sprugs kyi nang sgrub bzhugs so: na mo gu ru: i rgya u ti a ma: thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs la phyag 'tshal lo:

slob dpon padma'i thugs dam: mkha' 'gro ma'i snying thig: thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi nang sgrub la: dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed: stong pa'i ngang las padma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i steng du: skad cig dran rdzogs la rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas padma rā ga'i phreng ba bsnams pa: g.yon rin po che'i bum pa spyi blugs bsnams pa: sku ldem bag can: rgyan med gcer bu gzi mdangs can: spyi bor sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa bzhugs par bsam: sku la yum gsang ba ye shes 'khril ba: sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug: g.yon thod phrag: dbu la rus pa'i 'khor lo sogs rus pa'i rgyan cha dang rin po ches brgyan pa: dar dpyangs kyis mdzes pa: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul du yab la 'khril sbyor can: phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang dpa' bo sde bzhi bsgom: yab kyi lte ba la sgrol ma dkar mo: spyi bo na padma 'byung gnas yab yum: thugs kar padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag nas thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur par bsam: 'od zer tshur 'dus pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag nas ye shes rang gsal gyi don rgyud la skyes par bsgom: oṃ ma ṇi padme bam̐ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ hrīḥ 'bum tsho gsum ni bzlas gyur na: mchog gi dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur: 'di yi siddhi smos ci dgos: slob dpon padmas lho brag dpal gyi gnas skas kyi gter kha gu ru chos dbang la gtad pa'o// grub thob mdo bo ras chen pa/ des sprul sku rdo gdan/ des slob dpon dkon mchog shes rab la'o// thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi gtor ma byed par 'dod na: gtor snod ka pā la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pas bkang la:

rang nyid byang chub sems dang ldan pas: gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni: rang nyid lhar gsal bas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la: rang nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha tshogs spyan drangs la: 'bul ba ni: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun nam gsum la sogs pas phul la: hrīḥ skyed med chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bstan pa: sku mdog dmar gsal 'jig rten dbang du sdud: byams pa'i spyan gyis 'gro la thugs rjes gzigs: snyan gnyis thabs dang shes rab 'bul thabs mdzad: phyag g.yas bgrang phreng byang chub lam sna 'dren: g.yon pa bum pas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: zhabs gnyis 'gro ba'i don la ldem bag can: 'gro rnams ma lus thugs rjes dbang sdud pa'i: thugs rje chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos sku snang ba mtha' yas 'od dpag med: sku mdog dmar gsal sprul pa'i sku: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung : tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum bde gshegs gsang ba'i yum: thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'gro la gzigs: gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki ma: sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi tshul: rnam rtog rtsad gcod gri gug g.yas: 'khor ba dbang sdud thod khrag g.yon: thabs dang shes rab brkyang bskum mdzad: gnyis med tshul gyis yab la 'khril: 'dod yon rang dag rus pas brgyan: gzhon tshul che la cung zad khro: thugs rje'i chags pas dbang sdus la: nam mthong dran pas ye shes skye: thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: rdo rje rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: rin chen rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: padma rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: las kyi rigs kyi ḍā ki ma: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang dang dngos grub da lta stsol:

oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī: oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī: oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī: oṃ padma ḍā ki nī: oṃ karma ḍā ki nī: siddhi siddhi hūm̐: bka' rgya: gsang rgya: sbas rgya: rdzogs so: ༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi gsang sgrub zhugs so: ṭata:magpaṇṭagha3ṃ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa'i nang nas: le'u bdun pa yang snying gsang sgrub kyi le'u 'di la bzhi ste: bsnyen pa dang : sgrub pa dang : las la sbyor ba dang : 'gro don gyi las tshogs dang bzhi'o: thog mar bsnyen pa'i rim pa ni gzhung ltar nyams su blangs te: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kyi gegs las ngan gyi sgrib pa yin pas sgrib pa byang ba'i mtshan ma ma byung gi bar bsnyen pa shin tu gal che'o: gnyis pa sgrub pa bya ba ni: gnas dur khrod dam: gangs ri'am: shing gcig gi drung ngam: chu klung ngam: nags la sogs pa mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas su song la: gnas der bkra shis pa'i sa la maṇḍa la mda' gang gru bzhi byas te ba'i rnam lnga byugs shing bdud rtsis chag chag btab ste: de'i steng du chos 'byung padma dang bcas pa phyi rdo rje me ris bskor ba bris la kha dog tshon gyis bsgyur: de'i steng du mañdzi'i steng ka pā la mtshan dang ldan pa gcig la bdud rtsi lnga: sindhū ra dang : a mṛ ta dang : byang sems dkar dmar dang : mtshal dang chang sbyar la padma 'dab bzhi mu khyud dang bcas pa bri: de'i lte bar hrīḥkha sprod: padma 'dab bzhi la pho yig bzhi dang mo yig bzhi rgya yig tu bri: phyi'i mu khyud la ā li kā li dang rten 'brel snying po bri: de'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang byang sems dkar dmar dang sindhū ra dang a mṛ ta dang : gzhan yang rin po che gser la sogs pa dang : nas la sogs pa'i 'bru sna dang : ga bur la sogs pa'i sman sna dang :

rgyu za 'og la sogs pa'i dar sna dang : rgun la sogs pa'i shing tog dang : khug chos la sogs pa'i me tog dang : de rnams zhib tu brdungs la chang gi sbrus te ril bu sran ma tsam byas la: gong gi ka pā la de bkang ngo : dar dmar po kha gang gi rdzas rnams kyis dbang sdud 'khor lo bris la ka pā la'i zhal khebs bya'o: de'i rtsar sba lcag dkar po tshigs gsum pa gcig la me long lam pa dang dar dmar po kha gang btags: smyag shad khru gang pa gcig kyang btsugs: mgron bu padma'i lto ba can gcig gi nang du dar dkar la rtsa sngags kyi sham bur srid pa gsum gyi 'gro ba zil gyis non cig bya ba bris la bcug: ba mkhal smug leb cig tu dar dmar po la: khams gsum gyi 'gro ba longs spyod dang bcas pa dbang du sdus shig: ces bris la bcug go: zangs kyi ga'u cig gi nang du thugs rje chen po yab yum gyi snying po gser gyis bris pa dang : gzhan yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rten du dung man shel: rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rten du gser dang mu tig: padma mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rten du zangs dang byu ru: las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rten du dngul dang g.yu: de dag dar sna dang bcas pa sba lcag la btags so: rten pa'i gtor ma zas bcud can gyis brgyan pa bsham: gzhan yang rgyun gtor dang : tshogs kyi zhal zas dang : rdo rje dril bu dang : rkang gi dung dang : ltag sprod kyi rnga dang cang te'u dang gling bu la sogs pa bsham: de nas phyi mtshams nang mtshams bcad: de nas sems can thams cad bdag gi dbang du bsdus la dkar po dge ba bcu la bskul zhing : bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya: de'i ched du bdag gis thugs rje chen po bsgrub par bya snyam du sems bskyed la: de nas swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis snod bcud stong par sbyangs la: rang rig hrīḥdamar po cig tu bsam par bya:

de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs: bde bar gshegs pa la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs bsdus te slar hrīḥl thim pas bdag nyid thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis: g.yas padma'i phreng ba g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams te yum la 'khyud pa: zhal zhi ma khro mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa: sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa: zhabs nyi zla padma ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa: yum gsang ba ye shes zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sku mdog dmar mo: g.yas gser gyi ḍa ma ru bsnams pa: g.yon bdud rtsi'i ka pā la bsnams te yab la 'khyud pa: dbu skra sil bu thur du grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa: nu ma dang bha ga rgyas shing bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can: yab yum gnyis 'khril sbyor du bde stong gi nyams dang ldan par bsgom: de nas yab kyi dpung pa g.yas pa'i steng du rdo rje rigs kyi dpa' bo: dpung pa g.yon pa'i steng du rin chen dpa' bo: pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du padma'i dpa' bo: pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du las kyi dpa' bo: de nas yum gyi dpung pa g.yas pa'i steng du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: dpung pa g.yon pa'i steng du rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du padma mkha' 'gro ma: pus mo g.yon pa'i steng du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: de thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: g.yas gri gug g.yon thod phrag bsnams pa: rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o: de thams cad kyi gnas gsum du nyi zla padma'i gdan la yig 'bru gsum gyis sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab bo: de nas gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru las 'od zer 'phros pas snang ba mtha' yas kyis gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas spyan drangs la pū dza lnga phul te: bdag la dbang skur cig par gsol ba gdab:

rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas rigs kyi lha mo bum pa thogs pa lnga byung nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis bdag la dbang bskur bas: lus phyi nang gi sgrib pa thams cad dag nas: bdud rtsi yar 'khyil pa las dbang rtags su snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs kyis dbu brgyan par bsam mo: yang yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: ri bo po ta la'i pho brang nas thugs rje chen po yab yum bdag 'dra bar spyan drangs la pū dza 'bul: bstod pa bya: bdag la gnyis su med par bstim mo: de nas bdag gi thugs ka'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yig drug: yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma la hrīḥyum gyi snying pos bskor ba bsam: yab kyi lte bar dga' ba 'khyil ba la thabs kyi snying po lnga bkod: yum gyi lte bar dga' ba 'khyil pa la shes rab kyi snying po lnga bkod: bdag gis sngags kyi dzapra bzlas pa'i dus su: bdag gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer de lte ba'i dga' ba 'khyil pa la phog pas g.yon du 'khor bas 'od zer gsang ba nas yum gyi bha gar thim: de'i 'od zer gyis yum gyi dga' ba 'khyil pa la phog pas de rab tu 'khor ba'i 'od zer de thugs ka'i sngags phreng la phog nas: de 'khor ba'i 'od zer de yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du thim nas thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim par bsams la: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: oṃ gu hya dzñā na ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya sarba siddhi hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes bzlas pas gsang gnas gnyis kyi bar nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab pas: phyi snod kyi 'jig rten padma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang 'od zer dmar po'i rba klong 'khrugs pa: nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad la phog pas pho thams cad thugs rje chen po: mo thams cad gsang ba ye shes su bsgom: de dag gi snying la pho yig mo yig bzhi 'khor bas de dag yid bskul nas:

de thams cad ma ṇi padme 'brug sgra ltar sgrogs pa mchong ba dang : 'khrab pa dang : rgyugs pa dang : bro rdung ba dang : gar byed par bsam mo: zhabs gnyis kyi bar nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi dbang dang byin gyi brlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus te bdag gi zhal du thim pas bdag nyid bkrag mdangs gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam: mdun gyi maṇḍal phyi'i gzhal yas khang : thod pa nang gi pho brang du yig 'bru rnams thugs rje chen po yab yum gyi lha tshogs su bsam: bdag gi sngags phreng las 'od 'phros pas mdun gyi lha tshogs kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas: de las sprul pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma grangs med pa spros pas phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyi dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad dbang du bsdus: 'jig rten gyi longs spyod steng lha'i longs spyod: bar mi'i longs spyod: 'og klu'i longs spyod: khyad par du dpal dang grags pa: bkrag dang gzi mdangs: snying gi dkyil nas rnam par shes pa rnams dbang du bsdus te dngos grub kyi rdzas la bstim zhing ting nge 'dzin gyi 'phro 'du rgyun mi gcad do: de nas mthun bar gyi thun bzhir gtor ma 'bul: bdun phrag re la tshogs kyi 'khor lo re bskor: tshogs dang gtor ma'i dus su rkang gi dung : thod pa'i rnga dang : rol mo bkrol la 'di skad du bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo: hrīḥ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsang mchog 'dus pa'i lha: 'od dpag med kyi thugs las sprul pa ni: thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar ba'i mdangs: pad phreng bum pa bsnams nas shes rab yum la 'khyud: rus pa'i rgyan ldan pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs:

'gro ba 'dren mdzad spyan ras gzigs la bstod: hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum: sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: bde stong zung 'jug cang te'u thod khrag bsnams: gcer bu skra grol rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan: bcu drug lo lon sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul gyis yab la 'khril: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dngos grub char ltar 'bebs: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥ 'byung ba bzhi'i ngo bo rnam dag cing : yi ge bzhi las skyes pa yi: rdo rje'i rigs dang rin chen rigs: padma'i rigs dang las kyi rigs: dkar ser dmar dang ljang gu'i mdog 'dzin cing : gri gug thod phrag rus pa'i rgyan 'dzin cing : zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum kha ṭwāṃ gru mor brten: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las bzhi 'dzin: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad kun: rnal 'byor bdag la dus 'dir myur du stsol: bdag gi ci 'dod thams cad yongs rdzogs mdzod: ces bstod cing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab: bshags pa bya: bkra shis brjod: bsngo ba smon lam bya'o: de ltar nyams su blangs pas rtags rab 'bring tha ma gsum 'byung ste: rab lha'i zhal gzigs shing dbang bskur ba dang : byin gyis brlabs shing lung ston pa dang : dngos grub ril bu 'phel zhing dri dang rlangs pa 'byung ba dang : bdud rtsi dang gtor ma khol ba sogs 'byung ngo : 'bring nyams su sgra snyan pa dang : ḍa ma ru'i sgra grags pa dang : 'od dmar po dang : dben gnas dri bzang gis gang ba dang : lus 'dar zhing 'khrab pa dang : 'khor 'babs shing legs nyes smra ba dang : tha ma rmi lam du nyi ma shar ba dang : nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang : chos bshad pa dang : dar 'phyar ba dang : dung 'bud pa dang : 'gro ba mang pos bdag la bkur sti byed pa dang :

bud med kyi tshogs kyis bdag la zas nor ster ba dang : de ltar byung na rten rdzas rnams bsdus te: zil gnon mgron bu'i 'khor lo zhwa'i nang du bcangs: dbang sdud kyi 'khor lo ba mkhal gyi nang du bcug la mgul du gdags: rten pa ga'u mchan khung g.yon du bcang : zhal khebs dar dmar gyi 'khor lo sba lcag gi nang du gzhug: me long lam pa'i 'gro don sba lcag la gdags: ka pā la'i ril bu sum cha rten gtor gyi phud rnams maṇḍal de nyid kyi steng du tsandan gyi me spar: me'i klong du thugs rje chen po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa bskyed la: 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlabs la: oṃ sarba pā paṃ shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā: ā yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā: a tri nṛ ba su na na kha dhe pā shaṃ ku ru swā hā: sarba duṣṭāṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pa'i sngags kyis phul la bstod pa dang gsol ba gdab: me lha bdag la bsdu: ril bu 'ga' re bdud rtsi dang sbyar te bdag gis dngos grub tu rol: ril bu 'ga' ni gang dbang du bya ba la sbyin: 'ga' zhig dar du dril te thugs rje chen po yab yum gyi sku dang bcas pa ka pā la ru bcug la mis ma mthong bar rten du bcang ngo : gsum pa las sbyor la gsum ste: dga' ba 'khyil pa 'du ba'i las sbyor dang : me long lam pa'i las sbyor dang : gtor ma me mchod kyi las sbyor ro: dga' ba 'khyil pa 'du ba'i las sbyor ni: mi dang chos 'du bar 'dod na dga' ba 'khyil pa spyi bor bsgom zhing : ma nu dharma siddhi hriṃḥ pā shaṃ ku ru hriṃ dzaḥ zhes bzlas shing mi dang chos dbang du bsdus te spyi bo'i dga' ba 'khyil pa la bstim zhing : mkha' 'gro ma la gsol ba gdab bo: zas dang nor 'du bar 'dod na: dga' ba 'khyil pa mgrin par bskor zhing : ba su na na kha dhe ratna siddhi pā shaṃ ku ru hrīṃ dza: zhes bzlas shing zas nor thams cad sngags kyi 'od zer gyis dbang du bsdus la mgrin pa'i dga' ba 'khyil pa la bstim mo:

mkha' 'gro ma la gsol ba gdab bo: nyams dang rtogs pa skye bar 'dod na: dga' ba 'khyil pa snying gar bsgom: dzñā na siddhi puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā: zhes bzlas shing sngags kyi 'od zer gyis bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi nyams dang rtogs pa thamasaca da bsdus te snying ga'i dga' ba 'khyil pa la bstim: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la gsol ba gdab bo: mkha' 'gro ma bud med dbang du 'du bar 'dod na dga' ba 'khyil pa lte ba'am gsang gnas su bskor zhing : oṃ sarba ḍā ki karma mu dra siddhi pā shaṃ ku ru hriṃ dza: zhes bzlas shing sngags kyi 'od zer gyi mkha' 'gro ma dang bud med thams cad dbang du bsdus te gsang gnas kyi dga' ba 'khyil pa la bstim zhing : bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la gsol ba gdab: de'ang bye brag re 'grub ste: lus la bde ba 'bar ba dang : ngag la nus pa 'bar ba dang : sems la rtogs pa 'char ba dang : nyin mo mi dang chos 'du: nangs nub zas dang nor 'du: ci 'dod dngos grub thams cad char ltar 'byung ngo : gnyis pa me long lam pa'i las sbyor ni: me long la yi ge bdun pa gzhung bzhin bri: rang gi thugs ka nas yi ge bdun pa spros shing me long gi yi ge bdun pa la rgyun ma chad par bstims te: nṛ dza nṛ dza pā shaṃ ku ru nṛ dzaḥsha truṃ ha mu ka ni ā karṣa ya dzaḥhriṃ dzaḥ zhes pa 'di rtsa ba'i sngags la btags la bzlas shing me long la gdab: khyad par du dngos grub kyi ril bu dang sindhu ra dang padma rakta rnams dar dmar du btums la sngags gdab bo: de nas lam du zhugs pa'i tshe'am khrom du zhugs pa'i dus su: bdag bskyed kyi rim pa gsal bar bsgoms la: thugs ka'i yi ge bdun pa las yi ge bdun pa spros shing me long gi yi ge bdun pa la bstims pas: gong gi rdzas de lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du sngags bzlas pa'i mchil ma dang sbyar te me long gi yig 'bru la ser du mnan no: de'i lhag ma rang gi smin mtshams su thig le byas la:

'gro ba thams cad thugs rje chen po yab yum du bsams la: me long gi yig 'bru bdun las 'od zer 'phros pas 'gro ba thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam: lus lha: ngag sngags: sems ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar bya'o: de ltar nyams su blangs pas bdag nyid gang gis mthong ba'i 'gro ba thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'du zhing : mas bu gcig po mthong ba ltar dga' bar 'gyur ro: gsum pa gtor tshogs me mchod la brten pa'i las sbyor ni: dus thams cad du gtor ma btang la gsol ba gdab: nam phyed tshogs 'khor bskor zhing gsol ba gdab: tho rangs me mchod bya zhing gsol ba gdab: las sbyor de gsum las so so ma yin gcig tu bsgrub ste: 'dug na dga' ba 'khyil pa gtso bor bya: me long lam pa zhor la bya: 'gro na me long lam pa gtso bor bya: dga' ba 'khyil pa zhor du bya: gtor tshogs me mchod rgyun du bya'o: bzhi pa las tshogs ni gnyis te: phyi 'gro don gyi las tshogs dang : nang dngos grub kyi las tshogs so: phyi 'gro don gyi las tshogs la bzhi ste: nyi ma mkha' khyab dang : chu bo dbyings khyab dang : mchod rten dmigs gtad dang : me long lam pa dang bzhi'o: de dag gzhung nas ji skad bshad pa ltar bya ste: de dag mthong thos reg pas 'khor ba thams cad mtha' yod du 'gyur ro: nang phrin las kyi las tshogs la bzhi ste: zhi ba'i las byed na maṇḍal dkar po zlum por padma 'dab ma bzhi pa bris la lha'i sa bon bkod de: gal pa'i shing la sogs te zhi ba'i shing zlum por brtsig: dkar gsum dang mngar gsum dang til la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas bsham: rnam lnga'i mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham: bdag nyid kha shar du bstan la thugs rje chen po yab yum bsgom: maṇḍal gyi yig 'bru la 'od zer 'phros pas bskul don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus pas thugs rje chen po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa sku mdog dkar por bskyed: ye shes pa spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim:

rnam lnga dang ba liṃ 'bul: de nas bsreg rdzas 'dod yon lnga dang ldan par bsams la 'bul: sarba pā paṃ nad dang gnod pa thams cad zhi ba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā: zhes brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa tshang bar phul bas mnyes te: sku'i 'od zer gyis bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam: de nas bstod pa bya: gsol ba gdab: bshags pa bya: bkra shis bya: lha gshegs su gsol: dge ba bsngo: de ltar byas pas 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs pa zhi ba'i las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro: rgyas pa'i las byed na: maṇḍal gru bzhi par padma 'dab bzhi ser po bri: sa bon bkod la 'bras bu can gyi shing gru bzhir brtsig: gro 'bras rin po che dang chur ba la sogs bsreg: rdzas bsham: rnam lnga dang ba liṃ bsham: bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs gong ltar bsgoms te sku mdog ser por bsam: spyan drang ba sogs gong ltar byas nas: bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā: zhes bsreg rdzas brgya rtsa brgyad phul bas mnyes te: sku'i 'od zer gyis tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzad nas longs spyod kyi dngos grub char ltar babs par bsam: bstod pa la sogs rjes kyi bya ba gong ltar bya: dbang gi las byed na: maṇḍal zla gam padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi: tsandan dang rgya shug la sogs pa'i shing zla gam du brtsig: li khri dang : seng ldeng dang : sindhū ra dang : sha chang la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas bsham: rnam lnga dang ba liṃ bsham: bdag dang mdun gyi lha thams cad gong ltar bskyed la sku mdog dmar por bsam: spyan drang ba la sogs pa gong ltar byas la: ba su na na kha dhe siddhi pa shaṃ ku ru swā hā: zhes bsreg rdzas brgya rtsa brgyad phul bas: mnyes pas sku'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi longs spyod dang bcas pa thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'dus par bsam: bstod pa la sogs pa rjes kyi bya ba gong ltar bya'o:

drag po'i las byed na: maṇḍal gru gsum nag po 'dab bzhi bri: tsher ma can gyi shing gru gsum du brtsig: sha dang khrag dang liṅga la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas dang : rnam lnga dang ba liṃ bsham: bdag dang mdun gyi lha thams cad sku mdog nag por bsam: spyan drang ba la sogs gong ltar bya'o: gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bsreg rdzas brgya rtsa brgyad phul bas mnyes te: 'od zer mtshon cha'i gzugs can gyis bdag la gnod par byed pa thams cad rdul du brlag par bsam: bstod pa la sogs rjes kyi bya ba thams cad gong bzhin bya'o: de ni nang phrin las kyi las tshogs bzhi'o: thog mar bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags rdzogs par byas la: de nas phyi nang gi las tshogs rnam pa brgyad kyis rang dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub par bya'o: thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi gsang sgrub rdzogs so: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan padma'i gdams pa gu ru chos dbang la padma bsam 'grub: de las dbus pa'i rnal 'byor mi bskyod rdo rjes zhus so: ༈ 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi tshogs las dang bum chog gnyis bzhugs so: thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje chen po'i tshogs las kyi rim pa ni: dben pa'i gnas su tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i maṇḍal ltar bshams la: gdugs dang bla bre la sogs pas brgyan cing sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram: phyi'i mchod pa rnam lnga dang : nang gi mchod pa gtor ma dang tshogs kyi zhal zas thams cad rgyas par bshams: lag mchod kyi bdud rtsi dang bzed zhal yang mdun du bzhag: de nas sgrub pa po stan bde ba la 'dug ste: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la: mgron rnam bzhi la gtsang gtor sbyin: de nas bskrad cing mtshams bcad la srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya'o: de nas yan lag bdun pa byas la mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te: phyi'i mchod pa rang gi lha mor gsal gdab:

nang gi mchod pa thams cad me rlung gis byin gyis brlabs te: de nas thog mar bdag bskyed kyi rim pa rnams bya'o: de nas tshogs rten gyi lha tshogs mngon rtogs ltar bsgom: de nas lag mchod bya ba ni: bdud rtsi ka pā la de oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la: lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis dang po zlum por bskor: chos sku mtshon: de'i dbus su chos 'byung bris pas longs spyod rdzogs sku mtshon: de'i dbus su padma 'dab bzhis sprul pa'i sku mtshon: de'i steng du hrīḥlas thugs rje chen po yab yum bskyed la pū dza lnga phul nas: g.yas pa'i srin lag ro'i lha mos bdud rtsi'i mchod pa phul bas mnyes te: yab yum sbyor mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas lag pa'i chos 'byung khengs par bsams la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ kha raṃ khā hi khā hi: zhes mi skyo'i bar du phul nas bstod pa cig byas la: lha'ang 'od du zhu bar bsams la lag pa'i bdud rtsi ka pā lar bya'o: de nas bdud rtsi de rang la gtor bas lha'i dkyil 'khor du gsal gdab: gnas khang la gtor bas o rgyan du byin gyis brlabs: tshogs mgron la gtor bas dpa' bo dpa' mor byin gyis brlabs: tshogs gtor la gtor bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs: de nas rol mo'i sgra bsgrag: gu gul dang gsur chen gyi dud pa btang la spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐: lho nub o rgyan dur khrod nas: rig 'dzin bye ba 'bum gyi dbus: slob dpon padma gshegs su gsol: bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas: gsung mchog padma rigs kyi gtso: snang ba mtha' yas gshegs su gsol: ri bo ta la'i rtse mo nas: 'gro ba'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje chen po gshegs su gsol: mkha' dbyings rnam dag dur khrod nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas skyed pa'i yum: gsang ba ye shes gshegs su gsol:

'gyur ba med pa'i dur khrod nas: rdo rje mkha' 'gro= dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dur khrod nas: rin chen mkha' 'gro= chags pa bral ba'i dur khrod nas: padma mkha' 'gro= phrin las sgrub pa'i dur khrod nas: las kyi mkha' 'gro= ro langs 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon par bsam: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: sna tshogs rin chen 'bar ba'i tshogs khang 'dir: gdugs dang bla bre ba dan du mas rgyan: rin chen pad nyi brtsegs pa'i gdan khri la: gnyis med dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol: zhes mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsam: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: thugs rje chen po ye shes lha yi lha: yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la: dga' spro mos shing dang bas phyag 'tshal na: thugs rje brtse ba'i tshul gyis bzhes su gsol: na mo pu ru ṣa ya ho: zhes phyag 'tshal: hūm̐: yan lag brgyad ldan yon chab 'di: phyi yi mchod par bzhes su gsol: kha dog dbyibs legs me tog 'di: phyi yi mchod par: lhan cig skyes pa'i bdug spos 'di: phyi yi= ma rig mun sel sgron me 'di: phyi yi= spos dang sman sbyar dri chab 'di: phyi yi= ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas 'di: phyi yi= sil snyan rol mo sna tshogs 'di: phyi yi mchod par= ces phyi'i lha mor sprul la mchod do: de nas nang mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga: nang gi mchod par= thabs kyi sha chen rnam pa lnga: nang gi= shes rab bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga: nang gi= thabs kyi phung po rnam pa lnga: nang gi= dran rtog dbang po rnam pa lnga: nang gi mchod par bzhes su gsol: ces nang gi lha mo rnams sprul la 'bul lo: de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: thabs kyi rang bzhin yab rnams la: shes rab yum gyi mchod pa 'bul:

shes rab rang bzhin yum rnams la: thabs chen yab kyi mchod pa 'bul: thabs dang shes rab yab yum gnyis: mkha' gsang byin brlabs 'phro 'du las: bsrub dang bskyod pa'i sbyor ba yis: dga' ba bzhi dang bde ba brgyad: skad cig bzhi dang ye shes lnga: byang chub sems kyi mchod pa 'di: gsang ba'i mchod par bzhes su gsol: ces sbyor ba byang chub sems kyi mchod pa 'bul ba'o: de nas de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gti mug chos dbyings mchod pa 'di: sangs rgyas rigs kyis bzhes su gsol: zhe sdang ye shes mchod pa 'di: rdo rje rigs kyis= nga rgyal mnyam nyid mchod pa 'di: rin chen= 'dod chags bde ba'i mchod pa 'di: padma= phrag dog nan tan mchod pa 'di: las kyi= 'khor ba myang 'das mchod pa 'di: dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes su gsol: ces nyon mongs thams cad ye shes kyi ngang du 'bul lo: de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra sgrogs shing : mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs pa de: brgyud pa'i bla ma ma lags sam: 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: hūm̐: sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra sgrogs shing : mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs pa de: snang ba mtha' yas ma lags sam: 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: hūm̐: sna tshogs= mkha' la= thugs rje chen po ma= 'dir gshegs= hūm̐: sna tshogs= mkha' la= gsang ba ye shes ma= 'dir gshegs= hūm̐: sna tshogs= mkha' la= rdo rje mkha' 'gro= 'dir gshegs= hūm̐: sna tshogs= mkha' la= rin chen mkha' 'gro= 'dir gshegs= hūm̐: sna tshogs= mkha' la= padma mkha' 'gro= 'dir gshegs= hūm̐: sna tshogs= mkha' la= las kyi mkha' 'gro= 'dir gshegs= hūm̐: sna tshogs= mkha' la= 'jig rten mkha' 'gro= 'dir gshegs= hūm̐: sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra sgrogs shing : mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs pa de: chos skyong srung ma ma lags sam: 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: zhes tshogs kyi zhal zas bstab:

de nas tshogs phud gtor mar bcug la ba liṃ bsngo: mdzes stob drang : tshogs la rol: bstod pa bya: phrin las bcol: lhag ma bskyang : bkra shis brjod: bshags pa bya: glu bro bya'o: lha gshegs su gsol: dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bar bya'o: de nas rnal 'byor pho mo rnams ci bder bya'o: thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi tshogs las kyi rim pa slob dpon padmas mdzad pa rdzogs so: 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ gu ru padma/ jo mo mtsho rgyal/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug rtogs ldan padma bsam 'grub: mi bskyod rdo rje: myang ston dbon po'i phyag dpe las bris: gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos: skal med rnams kyi spyod yul min: skal ldan rnams kyi snying gi dkyil du bcang ba'i chos sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: i thi: ༈ bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs la phyag 'tshal lo: pad rgyun gzungs mchog gi cho ga la: dang po maṇḍal mda' gang pa ba'i rnam lnga la sogs pa gzhung bzhin byas la: padma 'dab drug dmar po mu khyud kyang dmar po bcas pa bri: gong ras dkar po dbus su hrīḥbri: 'dab ma drug la yi ge drug pa: lte bar bum pa dmar po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gzhung ltar bcas pa bzhugs: de nas sems bskyed la: stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid thugs rje chen po bsgom: bum pa bhrūm̐ las 'od dmar po'i gzhal yas khang du bskyed: de'i nang du thugs rje chen po sgrub thabs gzhung ltar bskyed: de'i dbu thog bum pa'i steng du thod pa'i ri lu la skad cig dran rdzogs la thugs rje chen po dus gsum sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bskyed la: de rnams thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs nas bdag gi sku gsung thugs la thim: bdag gi thugs ka nas gzungs thag la bdud rtsi 'khril nas bum pa'i nang du thim pas thugs rje chen po dpag tu med par gyur par bsam:

thun mtshams su mchod pa phul: bstod pa byas la: lha rnams 'od du zhu bar bsam mo: tshar nas gzungs chu la bkram pa'i dus su rang spyi bo'i thugs rje chen por bsgom: spyi bor yang thugs rje chen po bsgom: gzungs chu 'thung ba'i dus su spyi bo'i thugs rje chen po'ang snying gi dkyil du byon par bsam: de'i sku gsung thugs las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs nas: gang zag gi lus ngag yid gsum bde phril gyis song bar bsam: de nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhugs so: bsngo ba bya'o: bskor ba byed pa'i dus su phyi snod 'jig rten gzhal yas khang : nang bcud sems can thams cad thugs rje chen por bsgom: dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs bzhugs par bsam: sku gsung thugs las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pas: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam mo: lho brag gnam skas can gyi gter ma klu bdud kha nas bton pa'o: rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi le'u bdun pa'o: gu ru chos dbang gi thugs dam: des grub thob mdo bo ras pa la gnang ba'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi gsang sgrub rdzogs so: ༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi man ngag lhan thabs bzhugs so: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po'i gsang skor 'di la don rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas nyams su len te: tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyong gi don dang : rang gnas lha ru gsal ba'i don dang : mchod cing bstod pa'i don dang : rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi don dang : grags stong nyams 'phel gyi don dang lnga ste: dang po tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi don ni: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de: mdun gyi nam mkha' la nyi zla padma'i gdan gyi steng du jo bo thugs rje chen po sku mdog dmar po: zhabs gnyis gshibs nas bzhengs skur bzhugs pa:

phyag g.yas padma'i phreng ba dang : g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa: dbu gtsug ral pa'i steng du sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs pa de lta bu cig tu wal gyis bsgom: na mo: dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa ma lus pa bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus da nas bzung ste ji srid 'khor ba ma stong kyi bar du: 'gro ba tha dag gi don du bdag byang chub sems dpar gzung du gsol lo: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su mchi'o: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum gshegs su gsol: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum gshegs su gsol: bdag gi spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol lo: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa 'bul lo: nyams chag sdig sgrib thams cad so sor bshags so: gsang sngags sgrub pa byed pa la rjes su yi rang ngo : phyi nang theg pa'i chos 'khor bskor du gsol: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so: bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi don du thugs rje chen por gzung du gsol: de ni tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyong gi don no: de'i thugs ka nyi zla padma'i steng na yi ge hrīḥdamar po la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis bskor bar bsam: de las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la mchod pa'i tshul du phul bas mnyes par bsam: sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi thugs ka'i yi ge bzhi las 'od zer 'phros te: dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa thamasacad la mchod pa phul bas sku gsung thugs mnyes te: bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhal nas oṃ ma ni padme hūm̐ hrīḥzhes bya ba'i yi ge bdun gyi 'od zer dmar po bdag la phog pas bdag jo bo thugs rje chen por gyur par bsam: bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas: sems can thams cad la phog pas sems can thamasacad jo bo thugs rje chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur par bsam mo:

de ni rang gnas lha ru gsal ba'i don no: mchod cing bstod pa'i don ni: khams gsum sems can thams cad jo bo thugs rje chen por yod pa las: bdag jo bo thugs rje chen po la tshig bstod dang don gyi bstod pa phul: bdag gis mdun gyi jo bo thugs rje chen po la phul: des sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la phul: des dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la mchod cing bstod pa'i tshul du bsam: de ni mchod cing bstod pa'i don no: rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi don ni: dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshul du snang ba mtha' yas la thim: sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas mdun gyi thugs rje chen po la thim: de bdag gi spyi bor gdan drangs nas: bdag jo bo thugs rje chen po'i thugs kar thim: khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad jo bo thugs rje chen por yod pa de thams cad 'od dang 'od zer du rang la 'khyil par bsam: rang thugs ka la thim pas de sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas nas yi ge bzhi la thim: de rim gyis hrīḥl thim: de yang gi gu rim gyis mtha' nas dbus su thig le stong par lhan gyis thim mo: des ni rdo rje sems dpa' rang sa zin no: dus gsum dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob bo: yar sangs rgyas la re ba med de dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma la thim: bla ma rang gi sems la thim pa'o: mar 'khor ba la dogs pa med de khams gsum sems can rang la bsdu: rang bla mar bstim pa'o: bar gnyis 'dzin gyi thag pa bcad de thig le stong pa ngo bo nyid sku thob: spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral lo: grags stong nyams 'phel gyi don ni: me sgra dang chu sgra thams cad yi ge bdun pa'i sgra grags stong du bsam mo: i thi: ༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi sdig sgrib kun 'joms kyi sgrub pa

gu ru chos dbang gi u pa de sha'o/ bzhugs so: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs la phyag 'tshal lo: sdig sgrib kun 'joms 'di ni/ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa'i phrin las kyi le'u rtsa bdun pa nas gsungs/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyis ḍā ki ma gar gyi dbang mo la bka' stsal pa: shar phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med dpag tu med pa 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba yod do: de na gnas pa'i sems can rnams nyon mongs pa rags pa: drang bar dka' ba: gdul dka' ba: mi dge ba bcu spyod pa: mtshams med pa lnga byed cing spyod pa: bslab pa gsum yal bar dor ba: dkon mchog gi dkor la bab col du spyod pa'i sems can rnams la phan gdags pa'i phyir du: khyod kyis sdig sgrib kun 'joms kyi gzungs 'di zung zhig: chongs shig: klog cig: sdig pa can gyi sems can la ston cig: 'di la gces spras su gyis shig: bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa'i dpal brtsegs rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan shin tu brtan pa nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po zer ba dpe la lar 'dug bu'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag gi rig sngags 'di 'grub par gyur cig: oṃ bi pu la garbhe: ma ṇi pra bhe: ta thā ga te nirde sha ni: ma ṇi ma ṇi: su pra bhe: bi ma le: sā ga ra: gambhī re: hūm̐ hūm̐: dzwa la dzwa la: buddha bi lo ki te: gu hya a dhiṣṭhi te garbhe swā hā: padma dha ra a mo gha dza ya te tsu ru tsu ru swā hā:

bdag che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang : sgrib pa dang : las ngan pa'i rnam par smin pa dang : nyon mongs pa dang : sdug bsngal ba dang : bag chags ngan pa'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig: bde bar gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang : 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang : khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba: de 'dra kho na bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog: rigs kyi bu'am: rigs kyi bu mo'am: 'gro ba gang yang rung ste sdig sgrib kun 'joms kyi gzungs 'di nyin re bzhin du brgya rtsa brgyad bton na: mi mthun pa'i phyogs bcu gsum 'jig pa'i nus pa yod de: de'ang gang zhe na: me dang : chu dang : g.yang dang : thibs 'og dang : rlung dang : dug dang : mtshon dang : byad dang : rims drag po dang : dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba dang : gza' dang : gcan gzan ma rungs pa dang : mdze dang : rgyal po'i chad pa phog ste tshe'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro: gzhan yang yon tan chen po bcu gsum thob ste: de gang zhe na: rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de nyid gzugs bzang por 'gyur ro: dbyangs snyan par 'gyur ro: ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar bsgyur ro: sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa byed nus par 'gyur ro: phrin las thogs pa med par 'gyur ro: de'i sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ro: 'khor dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro: longs spyod zad mi shes pa thob par 'gyur ro: tshe ring bar 'gyur ro: bstan bcos thams cad la thogs pa med par 'gyur ro: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras su 'gyur ro: yid la re ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro: de ltar mi mthun pa'i phyogs bcu gsum 'jig cing : yon tan bcu gsum thob ste skye ba 'di yi 'og tu bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skyes nas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur ro:

de ltar yon tan nyi shu rtsa bdun thob par ma gyur na nga nyid kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad bslus par 'gyur ro: 'di'i cho ga ni: rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu bskyed la: thog mar sangs rgyas gsum gyi mtshan brjod cing : de rjes hrīḥs ya gcig bzla: de tsam gyi bcu cha gcig yi ge drug pa bzla: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: yi ge drug gi bcu cha gcig sdig sgrib kun 'joms bzlas te smon lam dang gsol ba gdab bo: tshes brgyad: bco lnga: nyi shu gsum: gnam gang rnams la rig sngags 'di stong rtsa brgyad du bzla bar bya'o: sangs rgyas gsum gyi mtshan ni sngags gsum yin pas brgya rtsa brgyad dam: nyer gcig gam: bdun bzla'o: oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ oṃ ā yuḥhūm̐ bhrūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: de rnams kyi bsnyen pa 'bum 'bum du bya'o: de nas byung ngo cog la stong rtsa brgyad bzla'o: de nangs re bzhin brgya rtsa brgyad ma chag par bton na gong du bstan pa'i yon tan thamasacad thob par 'gyur ro: the tshom byed pa ni ma gtogs so: rig pa 'di la bsnyen pa 'bum song na gang zag de nyid lus kyi sgo nas nyon mongs pa sbyong ba dang : brdeg pa dang : lus mi sdug pa bstan pa thams cad kyang ngan song las grol bar 'gyur ro: de nas gzhan gyis tshur byas pa thams cad kyang ste de bzhin du 'brel tshad thams cad grol lo: lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bzang 'brel ngan 'brel gang byas kyang grol bar 'gyur ro: sems can gzhan shi ba'i rus pa la nyer gcig bzlas na ngan song las thar bar 'gyur ro: 'gro ba 'chi kha ma rnams kyi rna khung du lan bdun brjod na ngan song gsum du ltung bar mi 'gyur ro: 'di nyid kyi bsnyen pa'i skabs su sha chang dang : sgog pa dang : phyi dro'i kha zas dang : 'khrig pa spang bar bya'o: bsnyen pa dus bzhi la ma grub na'ang nangs re bzhin brgya rtsa brgyad kyis 'grub bo:

stong gsum me 'obs kyis gang yang brgal la chos 'di btsal bar bya'o: phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun gyi dkor la 'bags te sangs rgyas stong gis bshags par mi gnang ba yang gzungs 'di stong rtsa brgyad kyis dag par 'gyur ro: 'di ni sdig pa can gyi gang zag phal pa la bstan par mi bya'o: ci'i phyir na 'di nyid kyis snyems byas nas sdig spyod du yong ba'i phyir ro: 'di nyid kyi phan yon nam yon tan ni bskal par brjod kyang zad par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro: 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi rgyud las: sdig sgrib kun 'joms kyi le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o: i thi: gu hya: 'di'i lag len ni: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med pa bzhi bdun rnam dag sngon du song nas: rang nyid 'khor ba dong sprugs su bsgoms la: de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gsum po gsum mam: nyer gcig gam bdun brjod pa ni thun 'go thams cad la'o: de nas grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni: hrīḥs ya gcig dang : ma ṇi 'bum bzla'o: de'i rjes su sdig sgrib kun 'joms khri tsho gcig bzla ba ni bsnyen tshad do: de ltar bsnyen pa'i tshul des sdig sgrib kun 'joms 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa'i gang zag de: lus mir 'dug kyang spyan ras gzigs dang tha dad ma yin no: spyan ras gzigs dngos yin no: i thi: gu hya: zab rgya: gter rgya: sa mā:tha:rgya:rgya:rgya: lho brag gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi thugs dam: chos bdag mi bskyod rdo rje'i snying tig dwags ston chen po nas brgyud pa skal ba can la sbyin par bya ba'i chos adbhu taṃ: shu bhaṃ: ༈ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi las tshogs bzhugs so: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ yi ge bdun pa'i las tshogs thun mong gi 'gro don bya ba'i rim pa la don bzhi ste: rgyud las kyang : me chu gnyis la yig bdun bri: mchod rten gsal byed de bzhin no:

zhes pas: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ me ni nyi ma ste: nyi ma mkha' khyab kyi 'gro don ni: lo gsar tshes gcig gi snga dro nyi ma shar thog kha shar du bltas te skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya: yi ge bdun pa'i bskyed rim bsgoms te: snying ga'i yi ge bdun las 'od zer yig bdun spros te nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chags par bsams nas: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes brgya stong du bzlas pas: nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi yi ge bdun las 'od zer oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥnyi ma'i 'od kyis gar khyab tu shar nas phyi'i yul thams cad zhing khams su bsam: nang gi sems can thams cad thugs rje chen po yi ge bdun par bsams te: bskyed rim mi bsdu bar rang bya ba gang byed la 'jug go: de nas lo zad pa'i tshes stong gi nyi ma zad khar rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom: bsngo ba smon lam bya'o: de ltar thebs bdun byas na nyi ma'i 'od mthong ba'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba la mtha' yod par byas pa yin no: ngan song dong nas sprugs pa yin no: nyi ma'i 'od phog pa'i sems can thams cad skye ba bdun tshun chad la 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par 'gyur ro: bdag gi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs nas: zhag bdun gyis bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong nas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par 'gyur ro: nyi ma mkha' khyab kyi 'gro don sprang ban chos dbang gi yi dam 'gro ba 'dren pa'i lcags kyu: dam srung bu slob rnams kyi dpal du shar: dam med the tshom can la 'di ma spel: i thi: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ chu ni gtsang po ste: chu bo dbyings khyab kyi 'gro don ni: chu bskyed spre'u zla ba'i tshes gcig la: rdo ba dkar po gtsang zhing mkhregs pa la gser gyis oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥgatso bor du bris te: chu 'dred pa'i rtsi btang la maṇḍal dbus su bzhag ste: yi ge bdun pas zhag bdun du bsgrubs te sems bskyed dang bskyed rim bsgoms la:

snying ga'i yi ge bdun las 'od zer yig bdun spros te rdo ba'i yi ge bdun la bstims nas gtsang po la bor bas: rdo ba'i yig bdun las yig bdun spros pas chus gar khyab pa'i cha yig bdun gyis khyab nas srid pa ma zhig gi bar du chu des lus la reg gam khong du song yang rung : mig gis mthong rung : tha na chu de gzhan du rgyu rung : chu las rlung byung nas sprin du 'khrigs nas char du babs rung : reg rung : phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'og dbyings na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyang 'khor ba mtha' yod par 'gyur ro: chu des khyab pa'i sems can thams cad kyang skye ba lnga tshun chad la 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par 'gyur ro: bdag gi yon tan yang nyi ma'i skabs bzhin 'thob par 'gyur ro: khyad par rtsod ldan gyi dus su thugs rje chen po'i phrin las 'phel lo: chu bo dbyings khyab kyi 'gro don i thi: gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi yi dam: 'gro ba 'dren pa'i lcags kyu: dam med the tshom can la mi spel lo/ rgya rgya rgya: ༈ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ dmigs gtad mchod rten gyi 'gro don ni: rigs kyi bu tshe ring zhing bde ba can du 'gro 'dod na: lug gi zla ba'i tshes gsum la zangs bum mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bcas te: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang : bskyed rim dang ldan par byas la bsnyen pa brgya tshar bdun bum par btab la bum chu rdo la bran nas: mchod rten bzhi mdor bzhengs shing : nang du srog shing la oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes bris pa'i mtha' mar gang 'dod pa'i gsol ba dang : smon lam rgya chen po bris la bcug ste rab gnas bya: mchod pa phul te: mchod rten de mthong ba dang : bskor ba byas pa dang : me tog gcig 'thor rung : yid dad pa phra mo cig skyes pa thams cad kyang 'khor ba mtha' yod pa smos ci dgos te: skye ba de'i 'og rol du bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur ro:

kham sa la mchod rten 'bum du byas te mchod pa byed na tshe 'phel zhing : tshe 'phos nas kyang bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro: yul phyogs der yang lo legs par 'gyur ro: nad dang mu ge dang 'khrugs pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par 'gyur ro: dmigs gtad mchod rten gyi 'gro don i thi: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ me long lam pa'i 'gro don ni: rigs kyi bu nam gsang sngags kyi lam du zhugs pa'i tshe: me long g.ya' dag pa cig la: sindhū ra dang : khye'u bu mo yul chos ma phog pa'i byang sems dkar dmar: a mṛ ta dang : mtshal dang : chang sbyar la: la mtshal sbyar bas bri: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥnṛ dza nṛ dza ba shaṃ ku ru nṛ dzaḥ sha truṃ 'di bzlas la gdag bri mi dgos a mu ka ni: ā karṣa ya dza dzaḥhrīṃ zhes bris te: bud med rma med kyi raktas ser du mnan nas: rang sems bskyed: bskyed rim gsal ba'i sgo nas snying po brgya bzlas te me long la gdab: me long gi 'od thams cad sngags kyi 'od du bsams nas: lag tu thogs te phyin na: me long de sems can gang gis mthong rung : reg rung : 'od phog kyang rung ste: bdag dang yi ge bdun pa la dad par 'gyur ro: de nyid kyi sgrib pa yang dung phyis pa ltar 'gyur ro: 'di nyid kyi skye ba de'i 'og tu 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par 'gyur ro: yang na me long de nyid kyang rang gi pho brang gi rtse'am shing ring po'i rtse la 'phyar bas: de mthong ba smos ci dgos te: de la rlung phog ste rlung des gar khyab pa thams cad kyang gong bzhin no: de'i 'od kyis lha srin thams cad dbang du sdud: khyad par du skyes pa dang : bud med thams cad dang : mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du 'du'o: byis pa'i tshogs kyang 'du la: bya'i tshogs kyang 'du: nor yang 'du la: snang ba dbang du 'gyur ro: ci'i phyir na thugs rje chen po de dbang gi rang bzhin yin no:

me long lam pa'i 'gro don sprang ban chos dbang gi snying thig khyad par can gyi gdams pa'o: i thi: 'di ltar thun mong gi yon tan kun la snyan par yang bsgrag par bya'o: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi rgyun khyer gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses mdzad pa bzhugs so// na mo/ sku gsung thugs ldan bla ma dkon mchog la: sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: kye ma rtog 'khrul ngan pa'i sems can rnams: rang ngo ma shes sdug la gtad: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phyir: snying rje chen por sems bskyed do: rtog med ngang las rang rig hrīḥ dkar dmar 'od ldan gdan steng du: gsang sngags rgyal po 'bru drug bskor: de nyid ma yengs 'od phung las: thugs rje chen po yig bdun pa: sku dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: dbu gtsug rigs kyi gtso bo bzhugs: phyag g.yas pad 'bru'i phreng ba 'dzin: g.yon pa bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams: rgyan med gcer bu gzi mdangs can: 'gro don zhabs gnyis bzhengs tshul du: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: thugs kar yig bdun gsal bar ldan: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes brjod pas snying ga'i yig bdun las 'od zer 'phros pas dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas tshogs rdzogs bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'od zer gyi tshul du bdag la thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs par bsam: yang 'od 'phros 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs su gyur/ bdag ci 'dra ba sha stag tu gyur/ snod kyi 'jig rten 'od du 'bar ba'i nang du bdag nyid 'khor bcas snang la rang bzhin med par 'khod de: 'gro drug gnas 'gyur gyi lha thams cad kyang yi ge bdun pa di ri ri sgrogs par bsams la bzla: skabs su: hrīḥ

rnam par mi rtog nam mkha' la: rang byung thugs rje chen po shar: rtsol bral 'gro ba 'dul ba'i sku: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: sangs rgyas mtha' yas dbu la bzhugs: phyag g.yas pad phreng dmar po 'dzin: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin: zhabs gnyis drang por gshibs nas bzhengs: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: rgyan med gcer bu gzi mdangs can: rang byung thugs rje'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes grag stong du 'ur 'ur bzla: mjug tu snying ga'i yig bdun las yig bdun mang po spros te rigs drug gnas gyur gyi lha thams cad yi ge bdun pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur nas bdag gi ba spu'i bu gar 'dus: bdag kyang gdan nas rim bzhin snying ga'i yig drug la 'dus/ yig drug hrīḥl 'dus/ hrīḥr btags nas gyen rdzogs su gi gu la 'dus/ gi gu mtha' nas dbus su yal ba ni 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa zhes bya ste/ 'khor 'das bdag gzhan gzung 'dzin ming 'dogs thams cad dang bral ba'i don la ma yengs par gnas par bya'o// ma 'gags par shar ba'i snang zhing srid pa thams cad kyang gtsang po la 'khyags ram chags pa ltar chos nyid kyi rol par shes par bya'o// de'i ngang las mi phyed rdzogs pa'i tshul du lhar langs la spyod lam bya'o// bkra shis// ༈ /thugs rje chen po'i yang snying gu ru chos dbang gi thugs bcud thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi lam dus kyi dbang chog rgyun khyer o rgyan bla ma'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs 'jam dbyangs chos rjes mdzad pa bzhugs so// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ na mo/ sku gsum thugs rjer ldan pa'i bla ma dkon mchog la: sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ kye ma rtog 'khrul ngan pa'i sems can rnams: rang ngo ma shes sdug la gtad: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phyir: snying rje chen por sems bskyed do:

lan gsum/ rtog med ngang las rang rig hrīḥ dkar dmar 'od ldan gdan steng du: gsang sngags rgyal po 'bru drug bskor: de nyid ma yengs 'od phung las: thugs rje chen po yig bdun pa: sku dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: dbu gtsug rigs kyi gtso bo bzhugs: phyag g.yas pad 'bru'i phreng ba 'dzin: g.yon pas bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams: rgyan med gcer bu gzi mdangs can: 'gro don zhabs gnyis bzhengs tshul du: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: thugs kar yig bdun gsal bar ldan: snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku: ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i tshul du bsgom: mdun gyi nam mkhar gdan nyi zla padma'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang bcas pa badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ spro na sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la sogs kyis spyan drang : mdun gyi bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyi dbu gtsug tu bzhugs par bsam: thugs rje chen po dang slob dpon spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hrīḥ na mo/ bkod pas mdzes ldan rin chen maṇḍal mchog: ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zlas brgyan: rin chen 'dod lnga kun bzang mchod sprin gtibs: dkon mchog bla ma yi dam lha tshogs mchod: bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus bskyab tu gsol: zhes lus longs spyod thams cad 'bul: na mo thugs rje'i bdag po dgongs: bdag sogs 'khor ba'i sems can rnams: bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir: thugs rje bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur zhu: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: yi dam du yang zhu bar bgyi: lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od dkar nar gyis byung*/ bdag gi smin mtshams su phog lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/

bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob/ lus thams cad byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'od dkar pos dkar lam gyis gang bar bsam/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar nar gyis byung*/ bdag gi mgrin par phog ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad dag gsung gi byin rlabs bzhugs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag par bsam/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag snying po bzla ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob/ lus thams cad 'od dmar pos dmar lam gyis gang bar bsam/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon nar gyis byung*/ bdag gi snying gar phog yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rtsa rlung thig le la brten pa'i rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob/ lus 'od sngon pos sngo lam gyis gang bar bsam/ dbang bskur bya skur byed sgrib pa dag ma dag gi 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i ngang la sems ma bcos par rang lugs su bzhag pa ni chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po yin no// zhes ngo sprod gsung bar bsam/ lus ngag yid gsum cha mnyam gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob par bsam/ dbang brtan par zhu ba ni/ o rgyan rin po che dang thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang dang bla ma dbyer med tu 'dres pa'i ngang la ci gnas su 'jog de'i ngang la rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa/ gsal la rtog pa med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu'i longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs la/ sems can gyi don yid bzhin nor bu lta bur gyis shig ces gsung bar bsam/ de nas gtor ma spyi bor bzhag par bsams nas/ spyi bo'i lha dang bla ma brtan par bzhugs te byin gyis rlob par bsams la/

oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ ba liṃ ta sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod/ slar maṇḍal tshar gcig 'bul/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rang la thim/ yang 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ snang ba thams cad thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur/ de thams cad kyis sngags 'ur 'ur 'dren par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes ci nus bzla/ mthar mchod pas mchod/ rnam par mi rtog nam mkha' la// rang byung thugs rje chen po shar// rtsol bral 'gro ba 'dul ba'i sku// thugs kar yi ge bdun pa gsal// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar// sangs rgyas snang mtha' dbu la bzhugs// phyag g.yas pad phreng dmar po 'dzin// phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams// zhabs gnyis drang por gshibs nas bzhengs// nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs// rgyan med gcer bu mdangs dang ldan// rang byung thugs rje'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces brjod/ mthar 'od gsal gyi ngang la ci gnas su bzhag cing dge ba bsngo zhing spyod lam bya'o// zhes pa'ang gnas gsar chos rje 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i phyag bzhes kyi rgyun no// ༈ /thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi dbang bskur bltas chog tu bkod pa nyi ma'i 'dzum zer zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ka nā thā ya/ snying rje'i gzi brjid tshad med pas// 'khor ba'i mun pa dong nas sprugs// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i sras gcig pu// de la gus pas phyag bgyi'o// thugs rje che mgon chos dbang gi// zab gter las byon sdig po che// tshegs med ngan 'gro las sgrol ba'i// smin byed gsal bar bkod 'di'o// de la bzhi/ dbang rdzas ji ltar bsham pa/ dbang sgrub ji ltar bya ba/ dbang dngos ji ltar bskur ba/ dbang gi rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/

rten yod na bshams pa'i mdun du stegs bu gtsang ma la maṇḍal ba byung gis chag chag gdab pa la padma 'dab drug mu khyud dang bcas pa dmar po gong ras dkar po can gyi dbus su hrīḥ 'dab ma drug la yig drug bris pa'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar bum pa nyer lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings dmar po can gyi khar/ bandha mtshan ldan chang gis bkang ba'i steng me long la mtshal gyis yi ge bdun pa bris pas bkab pa'i steng shel rdo dri med bzhag mdun ngos su sku tsaka dang sngags byang mtshal gyis bris pa/ sgrub thabs kyi glegs bam dar dmar gyis dril ba/ rgyab ngos su gtor chen padma brtsegs pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon tu sman raka mtha' skor phyi mchod/ gzhan yang las bum/ sngon gtor/ me tog sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams dang*/ tshogs kyi phrin las btang na yo byad kyang tshogs par bsag go /gnyis pa la/ gzhung 'dir phyi nang gsang sgrub gsum du gsungs kyang lha dbang gi skabs phyi sgrub ltar gsungs pa dang*/ de nyid rgyud las bstan pa'i rtsa ba'i lha yin pas rgyu'i dbang bskur de nyid la brten par rigs shing*/ de'ang sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lor sgrub pa gter gzhung ji lta bar byas nas dbang don bum pa sogs sgrub cing lam dus kyi dbang blangs pas 'thus mod/ spyi 'gre'i phrin las la brten par spro na las byang padma'i 'dzum zer ltar bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgrub/ bzlas pa ci 'grub byas rjes/ bhrūm̐ las bum pa thod pa me long rnams 'od zer dmar po'i gzhal yas khang du thugs rje chen po dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig gis gsal bar 'gyur/ bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te thugs rgyud bskul bas lha rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa dang thod pa khengs shing thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin tu byin gyis brlab/

slar 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros nas bdag dang slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur/ ces pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas gzungs thag drangs la yig bdun dang gzungs ci 'grub bzla/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ las bum du pad nyi'i gdan la khro bo rta mgrin padma'i dbyug gto dang sdigs mdzub can khro bo'i chas kyis brgyan pa'i skur gsal bar gyur// oṃ ha ya grī wa hūm̐/ zhes bzlas la byin brlab/ khro bo 'od du zhu bas bum chu bgegs srung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ de nas lam dus kyi dbang rgyas par blang ba'am/ bsdu na rig pa'i me tog dor la gnang ba nod pas kyang 'grub bo// gsum pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ 'phros don no// dang po la'ang 'jug pa dang dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ bgegs gtor btang*/ mtshams bcad srung 'khor bcas spyi 'gro dang*/ me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i lus can 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las ma brgal ba mtha' dag 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dbang phyug gi go 'phang mchog la dgod par bya/ de'i phyir du de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs shing lam nyams su len par bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gangs can gyi ljongs 'di 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i gdul ba'i zhing du gyur pa'i don gyis dngos dang brgyud nas 'phags pa nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba zab mo las byung ba'i phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los dus gsum du 'dus zhing kha lo sgyur bar mdzad pas/ de'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs gdams ngag gi bka' srol gsar rnying bka' gter las byon pa mtha' yas pa zhig mchis pa las/ 'phags pa nyid gter 'byin grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i gzugs su rnam par rol pa spang ston gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis lho brag gnam skas can nas khro chu'i klu bdud khru gang pa spyan drangs pa'i sku sked las byon pa'i chos sde/

khyad 'phags sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i nang tshan te/ bka' gtsigs las/ thun mong gi thugs rje'i sgrub skor ches mang gi: khyad par zhag bdun nges 'grub 'di na mchis: de gang zhe na 'khor ba dong sprugs skor: mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs: zhes dang*/ thugs rje chen po rgyud sgrub man ngag skor: thugs rje chen po rgyud sgrub lnga brgya brgyad: lung sde bsam yas man ngag rgya mtsho'i bcud: o rgyan ngas bsdus nyams su blangs shing nges: de phyir rin chen klu bdud thugs ka ru: sku dang bcas te gser gyi khyud mas bcings: bstan pa'i snying po yin gyi 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal: rgyud sbyong 'gro 'dul rtsa ba thugs rje che: rgyud sde lnga brgya'i bcud bsdus 'khor dong sprugs: dus mtha'i sems can gdul dka' 'di yis thul: lta yangs spyod bde sgrub rtags 'phral la 'byung : o rgyan snying khrag bstan pa'i btsas su bzhag: mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs: zhes gsungs pa ltar thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs thams cad kyi nang nas khyad par 'phags pa sdig po che btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba'i gdams pa/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa brgyad pa las le'u bdun pa yig bdun gsang sgrub dang 'brel ba'i dbang bskur zab mo bsgrub par bgyi ba la bdag gis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub pa lags pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i phyag rten du rin po che las grub pa'i me tog gi phreng ba phyag tu thogs par mos shig ces dar sna'i cod pan gtad/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la yid khyed shes kyi mos gus dang bcas te me tog gi brgyan pa'i thal mo sbyar la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/
