na mo: thugs rje'i bdag po dgongs su gsol: bdag sogs 'khor ba'i sems can rnams: bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir: thugs rje bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur zhu: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: yi dam du yang zhu bar bgyi: lan gsum/ bla ma thugs rje chen po dbu gtsug snang ba mtha' yas dang bcas pa phyogs dus dkon mchog rtsa gsum kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs pa la bdag sogs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad deng nas byang chub kyi snying po ma thob kyi bar du snying thag pa nas skyabs su mchi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ na mo: thugs rjer ldan pa'i sogs las byang ltar lan gsum/ sems can thamasacad 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i phyir du zab mo'i lam 'dir 'jug par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye ma rtog 'khrul ngan pa'i sogs lan gsum/ zhing mchog dam pa de dag gi spyan sngar phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa 'bul ba sogs bsags sbyong yan lag bcu pa tshul bzhin du bya ba'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ bla ma yi dam sogs brjod du gzhug sngar byin pa'i me tog gi phreng ba dkyil 'khor pa la phul ba'i mos pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ e ma hoḥ bdag gi rig pa'i me tog 'di: bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dbang dang dngos grub thob bya'i phyir: thugs rjes dgongs nas bzhes su gsol: pra ti pū dza hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor la 'dor du gzhug de nas ye shes kyi byin rlabs 'bebs pa yin pas/ 'o khyed rang rnams ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu sgoms shig snang ba thams cad 'od dmar po'i rang bzhin gyi zhing khams ya la la sgoms shig rang rang gi spyi gtsug na bla ma snang ba mtha' yas dang tha mi dad par gzi brjid dang ldan pa bzhugs nas rigs kyi bu bde ba can gyi zhing du yar shog yar shog gsung bar sgoms shig rang nyid thugs rje chen po dmar po rgyan med gcer bu pad phreng dang bum pa bsnams pa zhabs bzhengs stabs can/

snang srid thams cad yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro// dpa' bo dang dpa' mos gar byed cing rol mo mang po sgrogs te byin gyis rlob par mos la rig pa'i dpang bstod de gsol 'debs dang yig bdun dzab dbyangs lhan cig tu gsung 'tshal/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs so// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ gsol 'debs de dang yig bdun spel ba 'gre'o// longs sku thugs rje chen po la gsol ba= ḍā ki gar gyi dbang phyug la= sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la= mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la= gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug la= drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma la= mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong la gsol ba 'debs so// zhes gsol 'debs dang yig bdun dbyangs su blang*/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams thams cad thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs yi ge bdun pa'i skur bzhengs te che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba yungs 'bru tsam/ yang chung rdul phran tsam steng nas char bzhin babs/ bar nas bu yug bzhin du 'tshub/ 'og nas na bun bzhin du byung ste khyed rang rnams kyi dbu gtsug dang ba spu'i bu ga nas sib sib thim pas rgyud la ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs zhugs/ sgo gsum thugs rje chen po dang dbyer med du gyur par mos shig spos bsreg rol mo bsgrags la spro na las byang gi spyan 'dren brjod kyang rung*/ dkyus su yig bdun gyi gsham du/ badzra ā be sha ya āḥ.āḥbatags pa brjod/ de ltar dbab pa rjes kyi shes pa gsal stong 'dzin med du lhag ger shar ba de chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po yin pas shes par gyis la/ de nyid brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes rgya gram mgor bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi bskur ba la thun mong ma yin pa dbang bzhi'i byin rlabs rjes 'brel dang bcas pa dang*/

thun mong gtor ma bka' lung gi dbang gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po dbang bzhi rim par bskur ba'i thog mar bum pa'i dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ rnam rgyal bum pa 'od phung dmar po'i rang bzhin gyi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ las 'od dkar po nar gyis byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi smin mtshams su phog: lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad dag: sku'i byin rlabs zhugs: bum pa'i dbang thob: bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu sprul sku thob: lus thams cad byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'od dkar pos dkar lam gyis gang bar mos shig rnam bum spyi bor bzhag la/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs kyis: rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: lha dbang lus kyis thob par shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bum chu blud/ de'i rjes 'brel lha dbang lus la bskur ba la/ mdun bskyed kyi sku las ye shes kyi sku gnyis pa chad de khyed rang la thim par mos shig tsakli spyi bor bzhag la/ hrīḥ rnam par mi rtog nam mkha' la: rang byung thugs rje chen po shar: rtsol bral 'gro ba 'dren pa'i gtso: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: sangs rgyas mtha' yas dbu gtsug brgyan: thugs kar yig bdun gsal bar blta: phyag g.yas pad 'bru'i phreng ba 'dzin: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams: rgyan med gcer bu 'dzum mdangs ldan: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha dbang lus la rdzogs gyur cig: las dang skal par ldan pa'i slob ma khyod la: rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis thugs rje chen po yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur bas thugs rje chen po sku lnga ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can du sangs rgyas nas: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par gyur cig: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ

kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de'i rkyen gyis khyed rang thugs rje chen po'i sku shin tu gsal bar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dbu gtsug na snang ba mtha' yas sprul sku'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas dbang sdud kyi phyag rgyas padma dmar po phreng ba bsnams shing*/ g.yon mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas spyi blugs bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhi ma khro'i cha lugs gcer bu brgyan thams cad spangs pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis pad zla'i gdan la bzhengs pa las 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing snang la rang bzhin med pa zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i sku can du gsal thob cig rang lus snang stong dbyer med lha'i sku 'ja' tshon dang chu zla lta bur shes par mdzod la dus rtag tu bskyed pa'i rim pa 'di lta bu dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ bhandha rang byung padma'i gzhal yas khang du thugs rje chen po dngos su gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po nar gyis byung : bdag gi mgrin par phog: ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad dag: gsung gi byin rlabs bzhugs: gsang ba'i dbang thob: ngag snying po bzlas pa la dbang : 'bras bu longs sku thob: lus thams cad 'od dmar pos dmar lam gyis gang bar mos shig: thod pa'i bdud rtsi mgrin par bzhag la/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po lha tshogs kyis: gsang dbang bdud rtsi'i dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: gsang dbang ngag gis thob par shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes bdud rtsi sbyin: de'i rjes 'brel sngags dbang ngag la bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod: bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas yi ge bdun pa'i sngags phreng 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba byon/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal nas brgyud thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la hrīḥdakar la dmar ba'i mdangs can re gsal ba'i mthar 'khod par mos shig

sngags byang spyi bor bzhag la/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs ka nas: sngags phreng 'od zer dmar po 'phros: rang byung yi ge bdun du shar: yig drug rigs drug sgrib pa sbyong : hrīḥni ngan song skye sgo gcod: dus gsum sangs rgyas yang snying 'dis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsung 'grub nas: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ las dang skal bar ldan pa'i slob ma khyod la: gsung yi ge bdun pa'i dbang bskur bas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung du 'grub nas grags stong dbyer med kyi ngang la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur cig: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis bla ma dang thugs rje chen po la gus 'dud dungs pa re mdzad pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pa can 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas sgo gsum dug lnga bag chags dang bcas pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ slar yang bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i yi ge bdun pa las 'od zer 'phros pas: bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul bas de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum 'od zer dang bcas pa bdag gi gnas gsum du thim pas: lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs: yang 'od 'phros pas 'gro drug sems can thamasacad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur: snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang : bcud thamasacad thugs rje chen po snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can: yi ge drug pa'i sgra di ri ri sgrog par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ bi pu la garbhe: ma ṇi pra bhe: ta thā ga te ni rde sha ni:

ma ṇi ma ṇi: su pra bhe bi ma la: sā ga ra: gambhi ra hūm̐ hūm̐: dzwa la dzwa la buddha bi lo ki te: gu hya a dhi ṣṭhi te garbhe swā hā: padma dhā ra a mo gha dza ya te tsu ru tsu ru swā hā: lan gsum/ deng nas bzung ste dgra grags stong dbyer med rang byung chos nyid kyi rang sgra snying po sngags kyi rang bzhin tu shes par mdzod la dus rtag tu bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson par mdzod cig gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ me long 'od kyi gzhal yas khang du yig bdun thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po nar gyis byung : khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar phog: yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad dag: thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs: shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob: rtsa rlung thig le la brten pa'i rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob: lus 'od sngon pos sngo lam gyis gang bar mos shig: me long snying gar bzhag la/ hrīḥ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs kyis: shes rab ye shes dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yi: chos dbang sems kyis thob par shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥtsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rig pa me long ltar gsal la 'dzin med kyi ngang du lhan ner zhog cig de'i rjes 'brel chos dbang sems la bskur ba yin pas yid mig shes pa gcig dril du 'di la gtod cig shel rdo me long bcas spyi bor bzhag la/ thugs rje chen po rang dang gnyis su med: gzhan nas btsal med chos sku skye ba med: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rang byung rig pa rang shar chos kyi sku: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i dbang thob shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shel dang me long bstan la/ las dang skal par ldan pa'i slob ma rnams ltos shig: rig pa dri ma med pa shel lta bu:

gsal la sgrib pa med pa shel lta bu: sna tshogs su shar yang shel gyi gdan dang mdangs gzhan gyis kha dog sgyur ba yin gyi: ngo bo shel las g.yos pa med pa bzhin du rang gi rig pa byang chub kyi sems 'di thugs rje chen po las g.yos pa med do: de nas rang gi thugs ka'i yi ge bdun las 'od zer 'phros: snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu: rang gi ba spu'i bu ga nas tshur 'dus bdag la thim: bdag kyang thugs ka'i yi ge drug la thim: de yang dbus kyi hrīḥl thim: hrīḥyang rim pa bzhin gi gu la thim: gi gu yang mi dmigs par gyur nas 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par zhog cig byas la cung zad mnyam par 'jog tu bcug de'i ngang las skad cig gis thugs rje chen po'i skur lam gyis gyur par mos shig bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che bskur ba ni/ bla ma lha dang bcas pas dbang bskur bya skur byed kyis sgrib pa dag ma dag gi 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i ngang la sems ma bcos par rang lugs su bzhag pa ni chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po yin no// zhes ngo sprod gsung bas/ lus ngag yid gsum cha mnyam gyi dri ma dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob par mos shig hrīḥ thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs kyi: tshig dbang rin chen dbang mchog 'di: skal ldan khyed la bskur ba yis: dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par shog: snying gar bla ma'i mdzub mo btsugs la/ hūm̐: sems nyid ma bcos klong yangs na: rang byung thugs rje chen po bzhugs: gsal la mi rtog bde bar bzhugs: thugs rje chen por dbang bskur ro: sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi dbyings su/ rang rig rang gsal gyi sku dang ye shes su shar pa nyid/ dbyer med zung 'jug gsal la mi rtog pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po'i rang zhal mjal ba yin pas/

deng phyin chad sems nyid rig stong dbyer med spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i 'od gsal chen po'i gshis lugs su la zlo ba la brtson par gyis shig de'ang gang zag gi rgyud la ji lta bu zhig bsgom na: thos pa'i shes rab kyis snang ba sems su rtogs par bya: bsam pa'i shes rab kyis sems stong par rtogs par bya: sgom pa'i shes rab kyis snang stong dbyer med du shes shing rtogs par bya bar gsungs so: gnyis pa thun mong gi dbang gnyis las thog mar gtor ma 'di nyid snod padma'i snang ba rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang du/ bcud thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs rigs bdag 'od dpag med dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin tu gsal ba/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs pa'i tshe sku'i gnas rnams nas byin rlabs kyi rang bzhin 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa byon/ khyed rang la thim pas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur yongs rdzogs su thob par mos mdzod/ pad gtor thogs la/ gtor snod rin chen gzhal yas khang : gtor ma 'dod yon rnam pa lnga: yi dam lha ru mnga' gsol nas: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: yi dam 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan gyi: phrin las yongs rdzogs dbang thob shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥtrām̐: zhes gnas lngar gtugs/ las dang skal par ldan pa'i khyod la gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnam pa lnga'i dbang thob nas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par gyur cig: de nas bka' lung gi dbang ni sgrub thabs glegs bam spyi bor bzhag la/ las dang skal par ldan pa'i slob ma khyod la: 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi chos nyan du rung ba'i dbang dang : sgom par byed pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang : 'gro don byed pa byin rlabs kyi dbang rnams thob nas khyed rnams snying rje chen po byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa'i sgo nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig:

rdo rje'i slob ma so so'i ming sbyar la: zhes bgyi ba 'dis/ zhes sam mang po yod na/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyis sems can gcig gi don byed par gyur cig: gnyis kyi don byed par: gsum sogs re re bzhin sbyar la/ bcu'i don byed par gyur cig: nyi shu nas brgya'i bar gyi= stong khri 'bum gyi= sa ya'i= bye ba'i= dung phyur gyi= ther 'bum gyi= khrag khrig gi= stong dang po'i sems can gyi= stong gnyis pa'i sems can gyi= stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i sems can gyi= sprul sku'i zhing khams kyi sems can gyi don byed par gyur cig: longs sku'i zhing khams kyi sems can gyi don byed par gyur cig: chos sku'i zhing khams kyi sems can gyi don byed par gyur cig: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ dharmā a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ khyed rnams kyis thugs rje chen po'i bka' lung thob pa yin pas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs lta bu'i 'gro don rgya chen po 'grub pa yin no: zhes brjod/ rten snying dang shis brjod ji ltar rigs pa byas la me tog 'thor/ de ltar 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'i zab chos gter kha gzhan la ma grags pa'i khyad nor 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i smin byed kyi rim pa legs par grub pa yin pas sogs kyis mtshams sbyar la dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag maṇḍal phyin chad spyi ltar bya'o// gnyis pa 'phros don ni/ gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i phyag rgyun tu 'di'i 'phros su lam dus kyi dbang yang mdzad pa'i srol ltar/ rje bla mas kyang de ltar mdzad pas skabs 'di'am/ rjes chog grub nas kyang rung ste slob dpon rang nyid kyis mkhyen brtse'i yig cha ltar lam dus tshar gcig nyams len bya/ de ji lta bar slob ma la'ang dmigs pa spod cing mthar gtaur ma mgor bzhag cing maṇḍal phul bas 'grub bo// bzhi pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/

sgrub thabs ltar bla ma yi dam sogs dang*/ chos skyong gter gzhi rnams la dam can gyi spyi gtor lta bus gtor ma 'bul zhing*/ tshogs yod na byin rlabs nas brtsams/ shis pa brjod pa'i bar rgyas par bya/ tshogs mi byed na gtor 'bul 'phros su/ mchod bstod nongs bshags bsdu rim bsngo smon shis brjod bcas bya'o// lam zab 'di yis 'gro kun gyi// rgyud smin 'khor ba dong nas sprugs// cham gcig bde can zhing khams su// sgrib sangs ye shes rab rgyas shog /tshul 'di'i smin byed kyi yig cha rnying pa cung mi gsal bas gzhung dang bla ma'i dgongs pa gsal bar phyes te/ lha dang rig sngags 'di la mos pa padma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis thugs rje chen po'i pho brang gis mtshan pa'i lhun po glang chen 'gying 'dra'i sgrub gnas su sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// ༈ /thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gong ma'i phyag bzhes zla ba'i 'dzum zer ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya/ 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi sgom bzlas lam dus kyi dbang len pa dang dkyus gcig sdig sgrib kun 'joms kyi gzungs bzla bar 'dod pas/ rgyun khyer la sha chang sogs ma 'bags pa'i nangs mo'i cha dang*/ ched du bsnyen na sha chang sgog btsong 'khrig pa spong ba sogs gtsang sbra'i brtul zhugs la gnas pas/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na moḥ sku gsum thugs rjer ldan pa'i bla ma dkon mchog la: sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi: zhes lan gsum dang*/ sems bskyed ni/ kye ma rtog 'khrul ngan pa'i sems can rnams: rang ngo ma shes sdug la gtad: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phyir: snying rje chen pos sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ bdag bskyed ni/ hrīḥ rtog med ngang las rang rig hrīḥ dkar dmar 'od ldan gdan steng du: gsang sngags rgyal po 'bru drug bskor:

de nyid ma yengs 'od phung las: thugs rje chen po yig bdun pa: sku dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: dbu gtsug rigs kyi gtso bo bzhugs: phyag g.yas pad 'bru'i phreng ba 'dzin: g.yon pas bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams: rgyan med gcer bu gzi mdangs can: 'gro don zhabs gnyis bzhengs tshul du: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: thugs kar yig bdun gsal bar ldan: snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku: ma bskyed rdzogs pa'i tshul du bsgom: lam dus kyi dbang len pa'i phyir mdun bskyed ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gang na padma nyi zla'i steng du/ bla ma dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i thugs rje chen po/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ o rgyan nas slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la/ 'khor mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi: byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: zhes pas spyan drangs pa mdun gyi bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyi dbu gtsug tu bzhugs par bsam: thugs rje chen po dang slob dpon padma'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hrīḥgasal la/ maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ na moḥ bkod pa mdzes ldan rin chen maṇḍal mchog: ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zlas brgyan: rin chen rnam lnga kun bzang mchod sprin gtibs: dkon mchog bla ma yi dam lha tshogs mchod: bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus bskyab tu gsol: zhes lus longs spyod thams cad phul la: na mo/ thugs rje'i bdag po dgongs su gsol: bdag sogs 'khor ba'i sems can rnams: bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir: thugs rje bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur zhu: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: yi dam du yang zhu bar bgyi:

zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od dkar nar gyis byung : bdag gi smin mtshams su phog: lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag: sku'i byin rlabs bzhugs: bum pa'i dbang thob: bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu sprul sku thob: lus thams cad byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'od dkar pos dkar lam gyis gang bar bsam: mgrin par āḥlas 'od dmar nar gyis byung : bdag gi mgrin pa las bzhugs: ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad dag: gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag par bsam: gsang ba'i dbang thob: ngag snying po bzla ba la dbang : 'bras bu longs sku thob: lus thams cad 'od dmar pos dmar lam gyis gang bar bsam: thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po nar gyis byung : bdag gi snying gar thim: yid kyi dri ma dag: thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs: shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob: rtsa rlung thig le la brten pa'i rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu chos sku thob: lus thams cad 'od sngon pos sngo lam gyis gang bar bsam: dbang bskur bya skur byed sgrib pa dag ma dag gi 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i ngang la sems ma bcos par rang lugs su bzhag pa ni: chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po yin no: zhes ngo sprod gsung bar bsam: lus ngag yid gsum cha mnyam gyi dri ma dag: dbang bzhi pa thob: chos nyid don gyi thugs rje chen po bsgom pa la dbang : 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob par bsam: dbang brtan par zhu ba ni: o rgyan rin po che dang thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang dang bla ma dbyer med du 'dres pa'i ngang la ci gnas su bzhag: de'i ngang las rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur bzhengs la:

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thamasacad kyis sems can gyi don yid bzhin nor bu ltar gyis shig: ces gsung bar bsam/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po rang sgra sgrog par bsam: de'i mtha' bskor du yi ge bdun ma: de'i mthar gzungs ring gis bskor bar bsam: sngags kyi phreng ba dmar po g.yas bskor du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa phul bas tshogs rdzogs: gnas gsum nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od zer gyi tshul du rang la thim pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs: slar yang sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku'i byin rlabs thugs rje chen po: gsung gi byin rlabs gzungs sngags kyi rnam pa: thugs kyi byin rlabs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par bsdus te rang gi gnas gsum du thim: mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob par bsam: yang 'od zer 'phros: 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can la phog pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs: phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang : nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad thugs rje chen por gyur nas yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyi sgra bung ba tshang zhig pa lta bu 'ur di ri ri sgrog par bsams la yi ge bdun pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar bzlas par bya'o// de nas sdig sgrib kun 'joms kyi gzungs bzla bar 'dod na/ slar yang sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros: rang gi lus thams cad gang bas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sangs kyis dag pa de las 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phros pas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa byang nas thugs rje chen po'i sku snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa sha stag tu gyur par bsams la/ thog mar/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo:

oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ sangs rgyas ma chags padma can la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ bhrūm̐ ā yur hūm̐ nṛ dzaḥ sangs rgyas thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ rnams dang*/ hrīḥ'i bzlas pa sngon tu song nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser 'od seng ge rnam par rol pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa'i dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan shin tu brtan pa nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag gi rig sngags 'di 'grub par gyur cig: oṃ bi pu la garbhe: ma ṇi pra bhe: ta thā ga te: nirdhe sha ni: ma ṇi ma ṇi su pra bhe: bi ma la sā ga ra: gambhī ra hūm̐ hūm̐: dzwa la dzwa la: buddha bi lo ki te: gu hya a dhiṣṭhi te garbhe swā hā: padma dha ra a mo gha dza ya te tsu ru tsu ru swā hā: zhes bzlas rjes/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa las ngan pa'i rnam par smin pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang : sdug bsngal ba dang : bag chags ngan pa'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas ma lus pa byang zhing dag par gyur te: sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig: ces brjod/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta ārya lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri bā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ rnam par mi rtog nam mkha' la: rang byung thugs rje chen po shar: rtsol bral 'gro ba 'dul ba'i sku: thugs kar yi ge bdun pa gsal: zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar: sangs rgyas mtha' yas dbu la bzhugs: phyag g.yas shel phreng dmar po 'dzin: g.yon pas bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams: zhabs gnyis drang por gshibs te bzhengs:

nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: rgyan med gcer bu mdangs dang ldan: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs mdzad pa'i: rang byung thugs rje'i dpal la bstod: dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bzlas pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ thugs ka'i yig bdun las mang po spros te rigs drug gnas 'gyur gyi lha thams cad yi ge bdun pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur nas bdag gi ba spu'i bu gar 'dus/ bdag kyang rim bzhin snying ga'i sngags la 'dus/ de hrīḥl 'dus/ hrīḥyang gyen rdzogs su 'dus nas mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur/ ces lha snang chos nyid du bsdu/ slar thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur/ snang grags thams cad lha sngags chos nyid kyi rol pa'o// zhes mos la dge bsngo bya/ 'di las 'khor ba dong sprugs rtsa ba'i rgyun khyer kho na bya bar 'dod na/ dbang len phyin chad mi dgos pas/ skyabs sems mngon rtogs tsam brjod nas yig bdun bzla zhing*/ mjug tu'ang bstod pa kho na dang bsdu ldangs dge bsngo byas pas 'grub bo// 'di la brten nas sdig sgrib kun 'joms kyi bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod na/ sangs rgyas gsum gyi mtshan nyer gcig gam bdun re dang*/ snying po gong ma gnyis 'bum ther re/ yig drug bye ba re/ hrīḥkho na sa ya/ gzungs ring 'bum phrag gcig bzla ba ni rab yin la/ sangs rgyas gsum gyi snying po ci 'grub dang gzungs ring khri tsho tsam bzlas kyang phan yon shin tu che la/ yang nangs re brgya rtsa brgyad re ma chags pa dang*/ dus bzang rnams su bsnyen gnas sam smyung bar gnas pa gang rung dang 'brel bar gzungs stong rtsa brgyad bzlas na'ang sdig pa tshad med pa 'joms par gsungs la mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs bcu gsum 'jig cing phan yon bcu gsum thob pa dang*/ gzungs 'bum ther song ba de lus mir 'dug kyang spyan ras gzigs dngos yin pa dang*/ gzungs 'dis shi ba'i rus pa la btab na sems can de ngan song las thar ba dang*/

'chi ka ma'i rna lam du lan bdun brjod na ngan song gsum du mi ltung ba sogs phan yon tshad med par gsungs pas rgyu sdig sgrib dang 'bras bu 'khor ba ngan song las thar bar 'dod pa'i blo can mchis na 'di kho na la g.yar dam du bya bar rigs so// stong gsum me 'obs kyis gang yang*// brgal nas btsal bya zab mo'i chos// dbul pos nor rnyed ji bzhin tu// snying gi thig ler 'dzin par rigs// zhes pa'ang blo gros mtha' yas sdes gsal bar bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
